221.name: Worgen in the Woods
objectivesText: Kill 12 Nightbane Dark Runner worgen for Calor in Darkshire.

222.name: Worgen in the Woods
objectivesText: Kill 8 Nightbane Vile Fang and 8 Nightbane Tainted One worgen for Calor in Darkshire.

223.name: Worgen in the Woods
objectivesText: Bring Calor's note to Jonathan Carevin.

224.name: In Defense of the King's Lands
objectivesText: Mountaineer Cobbleflint of the southern guard tower wants you to kill 10 Stonesplinter Troggs and 10 Stonesplinter Scouts.

225.name: The Weathered Grave
objectivesText: Speak with Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire.

226.name: Wolves at Our Heels
objectivesText: Kill 12 Starving Dire Wolves and 8 Rabid Dire Wolves, then return to Lars at Sven's Camp on the western border of Duskwood.

227.name: Morgan Ladimore
objectivesText: Speak with Commander Althea Ebonlocke in Darkshire.

228.name: Mor'Ladim
objectivesText: Kill Mor'Ladim, then return his skull to Commander Althea Ebonlocke in Darkshire.

229.name: The Daughter Who Lived
objectivesText: Speak with Watcher Sarah Ladimore in Darkshire.

230.name: Sven's Camp
objectivesText: Bring the Book from Sven's Farm to Sven.

231.name: A Daughter's Love
objectivesText: Take Sarah Ladimore's ring to Morgan Ladimore's grave.

232.name: Errand for Apothecary Zinge
objectivesText: Take the purchase order to Alessandro Luca in the Undercity.

233.name: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery
objectivesText: Deliver the stack of letters to Talin Keeneye.

234.name: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery
objectivesText: Deliver the letter to Grelin Whitebeard.

235.name: The Ashenvale Hunt
objectivesText: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.

8427.name: Battle of Warsong Gulch
objectivesText: Bring 3 Warsong Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

237.name: In Defense of the King's Lands
objectivesText: Mountaineer Gravelgaw in the southern guard tower wants you to kill 10 Stonesplinter Skullthumpers and 10 Stonesplinter Seers and report back to him.

238.name: Errand for Apothecary Zinge
objectivesText: Bring the Field Sampling Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.

239.name: Westbrook Garrison Needs Help!
objectivesText: Go to the Westbrook Garrison and speak with Deputy Rainer.

240.name: Return to Jitters
objectivesText: Return to Jitters with the Dusky Crab Cakes.

243.name: Into the Field
objectivesText: Speak to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan about getting a power source for the testing kit.

244.name: Encroaching Gnolls
objectivesText: Report to Deputy Feldon.

245.name: Eight-Legged Menaces
objectivesText: Kill 15 Pygmy Venom Web Spiders, and then report back to Watcher Dodds in Duskwood.

246.name: Assessing the Threat
objectivesText: Kill 10 Redridge Mongrels and 6 Redridge Poachers, then report back to Deputy Feldon in Lakeshire.

248.name: Looking Further
objectivesText: Climb the intact watch tower beside Stonewatch Keep.
Find a suitable container to place the Glyph of Azora.

249.name: Morganth
objectivesText: Defeat Morganth.
Bring his Pendant of Shadow to Theocritus at the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest.

250.name: A Dark Threat Looms
objectivesText: Investigate the area near the eastern ramp of the Dam and bring Chief Engineer Hinderweir a clue that might reveal what the Dark Iron Dwarves are up to.

251.name: Translate Abercrombie's Note
objectivesText: Bring the Letter to Ello to Sirra Von'Indi.

252.name: Translation to Ello
objectivesText: Bring the Translated Letter to Lord Ello Ebonlocke

253.name: Bride of the Embalmer
objectivesText: Find Eliza's grave. Retrieve the Embalmer's Heart from her, then return to Ello Ebonlocke.

255.name: Mercenaries
objectivesText: Magistrate Bluntnose of Thelsamar has hired you to kill 4 Mo'grosh Ogres, 4 Mo'grosh Brutes and 4 Mo'grosh Enforcers.

256.name: WANTED: Chok'sul
objectivesText: Kill Chok'sul and bring his head to Magistrate Bluntnose of Thelsamar.

257.name: A Hunter's Boast
objectivesText: Kill 6 Mountain Buzzards and return to Daryl the Youngling in the Farstrider Lodge within 15 minutes.

258.name: A Hunter's Challenge
objectivesText: Kill 5 Elder Mountain Boars and return to Daryl the Youngling in the Farstrider Lodge within 12 minutes.

261.name: Down the Scarlet Path
objectivesText: Destroy 30 Undead Ravagers, then return to Brother Anton at Nijel's Point.

262.name: The Shadowy Figure
objectivesText: Take the book you found at Sven's farm and show it to townsfolk in Darkshire.

263.name: In Defense of the King's Lands
objectivesText: Mountaineer Wallbang in the southern guard tower wants you to kill 10 Stonesplinter Shaman and 10 Stonesplinter Bonesnappers.

264.name: Until Death Do Us Part
objectivesText: Place Clarice's Pendant on Yuriv's Tomb in Silverpine.

265.name: The Shadowy Search Continues
objectivesText: See if other townsfolk have clues about the shadowy figure.

266.name: Inquire at the Inn
objectivesText: Search the inn for clues about the shadowy figure.

267.name: The Trogg Threat
objectivesText: Bring 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to Captain Rugelfuss in the southern guard tower.

268.name: Return to Sven
objectivesText: Return to Sven with Jitters' completed journal.

269.name: Seeking Wisdom
objectivesText: Give Jitters' Completed Journal to Bishop Farthing in Stormwind.

270.name: The Doomed Fleet
objectivesText: Go to Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands, and speak with Glorin Steelbrow.

271.name: Vyrin's Revenge
objectivesText: Kill Ol' Sooty then show your handiwork to Daryl the Youngling at the Farstrider Lodge.

272.name: Trial of the Sea Lion
objectivesText: Find the Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility and the Half Pendant of Aquatic Endurance. Speak with the residents of Moonglade to learn clues as to where these items may be located.
Form the Pendant of the Sea Lion from the two pendant halves. You need to be in proximity of the Shrine of Remulos to do this.
Bring the joined pendant to Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

273.name: Resupplying the Excavation
objectivesText: Speak with Huldar.

274.name: A Dark Threat Looms
objectivesText: Ashlan Stonesmirk wants you to return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir and inform him of the new discovery.

275.name: Blisters on The Land
objectivesText: Kill 12 Fen Creepers, then return to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.

276.name: Tramping Paws
objectivesText: Kill 15 Mosshide Gnolls and 10 Mosshide Mongrels, then return to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.

277.name: Fire Taboo
objectivesText: Bring Rethiel the Greenwarden 9 Crude Flints.

278.name: A Dark Threat Looms
objectivesText: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to gather Lurker Venom, a Mo'grosh Crystal, and a Crocolisk Tear.

279.name: Claws from the Deep
objectivesText: Kill 12 Bluegill Murlocs.
Slay Gobbler and take his head.
Bring Gobbler's Head to Karl Boran in Menethil Harbor.

280.name: A Dark Threat Looms
objectivesText: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to swim down to the base of the dam, locate the powder keg and stir in the Disarming Mixture to prevent an explosion.

281.name: Reclaiming Goods
objectivesText: Search the crates and barrels at the coastal Murloc camps.

282.name: Senir's Observations
objectivesText: Speak with Mountaineer Thalos.

283.name: A Dark Threat Looms
objectivesText: The Disarming Mixture seemed to take effect. Return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir to report the good news.

284.name: The Search Continues
objectivesText: Search for the Menethil Statuette.

285.name: Search More Hovels
objectivesText: Continue searching the Murloc hovels for the Menethil Statuette.

286.name: Return the Statuette
objectivesText: Bring Karl Boran the Menethil Statuette.

287.name: Frostmane Hold
objectivesText: Explore Frostmane Hold, and kill 5 Frostmane Headhunters for Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.

288.name: The Third Fleet
objectivesText: Buy First Mate Fitzsimmons a Flagon of Mead.

289.name: The Cursed Crew
objectivesText: Kill 13 Cursed Sailors, 5 Cursed Marines and First Mate Snellig. Bring Snellig's Snuffbox to First Mate Fitzsimmons in Menethil Harbor.

290.name: Lifting the Curse
objectivesText: Get the Intrepid Strongbox Key from Captain Halyndor.
Use the key to open the Intrepid's Locked Strongbox.

291.name: The Reports
objectivesText: Deliver Senir's report to Senator Barin Redstone in Ironforge.

292.name: The Eye of Paleth
objectivesText: Bring the Cursed Eye of Paleth to Glorin Steelbrow.

293.name: Cleansing the Eye
objectivesText: Bring Archbishop Benedictus the Cursed Eye of Paleth. Benedictus is in the Cathedral of Light, in the city of Stormwind.

294.name: Ormer's Revenge
objectivesText: Ormer Ironbraid at the Whelgar Excavation Site wants you to kill 10 Mottled Screechers and 10 Mottled Raptors.

295.name: Ormer's Revenge
objectivesText: Ormer Ironbraid wants you to kill 10 Mottled Scytheclaw raptors and 10 Mottled Razormaw raptors then return to him at the Whelgar Excavation Site.

296.name: Ormer's Revenge
objectivesText: Ormer Ironbraid at the Whelgar Excavation Site wants you to kill Sarltooth and return to him with one of his talons once the task is fulfilled.

297.name: Gathering Idols
objectivesText: Bring Magmar Fellhew 8 Carved Stone Idols.

298.name: Excavation Progress Report
objectivesText: Bring Ironband's Progress Report to Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar.

299.name: Uncovering the Past
objectivesText: Prospector Whelgar wants you to scour the excavation site in search of the 4 missing tablet fragments: Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru.

301.name: Report to Ironforge
objectivesText: Take Ironband's Progress Report to Prospector Stormpike.

302.name: Powder to Ironband
objectivesText: Speak with Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar.

303.name: The Dark Iron War
objectivesText: Motley Garmason at Dun Modr wants you to kill 10 Dark Iron Dwarves, 5 Dark Iron Tunnelers, 5 Dark Iron Saboteurs and 5 Dark Iron Demolitionists.

304.name: A Grim Task
objectivesText: Kill Balgaras the Foul and bring his ear to Longbraid the Grim outside of Dun Modr.

305.name: In Search of The Excavation Team
objectivesText: Tarrel Rockweaver wants you to travel to the Excavation Site and contact Merrin Rockweaver.

306.name: In Search of The Excavation Team
objectivesText: Return to Tarrel Rockweaver with Merrin's note.

307.name: Filthy Paws
objectivesText: Go to the Silver Stream Mine and collect 4 loads of Miners' Gear.
Return to Mountaineer Stormpike.

309.name: Protecting the Shipment
objectivesText: Ensure Miran and the shipment arrive at the excavation site, then inform Prospector Ironband.

310.name: Bitter Rivals
objectivesText: In the basement of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, replace a barrel of Thunder Ale with a Barrel of Barleybrew Scalder.

311.name: Return to Marleth
objectivesText: Bring the barrel of Thunder Ale to Marleth Barleybrew at the Brewnall Village.

312.name: Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash
objectivesText: Retrieve Tundra MacGrann's dried meats from the stolen meat locker in Old Icebeard's cave.

313.name: The Grizzled Den
objectivesText: Gather 8 Wendigo Manes and bring them to Pilot Stonegear.

314.name: Protecting the Herd
objectivesText: Rudra Amberstill wants you to slay Vagash and bring his fang to her at the Ram ranch.

315.name: The Perfect Stout
objectivesText: Bring 6 Shimmerweeds to Rejold Barleybrew in the Brewnall Village.

8507.name: Field Duty
objectivesText: Report for duty at the Ironforge Brigade post near Hive'Zora. Prepare your Unsigned Field Duty Papers and obtain Signed Field Duty Papers from Captain Blackanvil and return to Windcaller Kaldon at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
Note: Healing or casting beneficial spells on a member of the Ironforge Brigade will flag you for PvP.

317.name: Stocking Jetsteam
objectivesText: Gather 4 Chunks of Boar Meat and 2 Thick Bear Furs, and deliver them to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot.

318.name: Evershine
objectivesText: Get a cask of Evershine from Rejold Barleybrew in Brewnall Village.

319.name: A Favor for Evershine
objectivesText: Kill 6 Ice Claw Bears, 8 Elder Crag Boars, and 8 Snow Leopards, and then return to Rejold Barleybrew in Brewnall Village.

320.name: Return to Bellowfiz
objectivesText: Give the cask of Evershine to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot.

321.name: Lightforge Iron
objectivesText: Search the wreckage of The Flying Osprey in the Wetlands.

322.name: Blessed Arm
objectivesText: Take the Crate of Lightforge Ingots to Grimand Elmore in Stormwind.

323.name: Proving Your Worth
objectivesText: Kill 15 Skeletal Raiders, 3 Skeletal Healers and 3 Skeletal Warders, and then return to Sven.

324.name: The Lost Ingots
objectivesText: Gather 5 Lightforge Ingots, then return to Glorin Steelbrow in the Wetlands.

325.name: Armed and Ready
objectivesText: Bring Morbent's Bane to Sven in Duskwood.

8517.name: The Alliance Needs Linen Bandages!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Linen Bandages to Sentinel Silversky at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8518.name: The Alliance Needs More Linen Bandages!
objectivesText: Bring 20 linen bandages to Sentinel Silversky at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

328.name: The Hidden Key
objectivesText: Use the Small Brass Key to open Bookie Herod's Strongbox.

329.name: The Spy Revealed!
objectivesText: Take the Muddy Note to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.

330.name: Patrol Schedules
objectivesText: Speak with Corporal Sethman.

331.name: Report to Doren
objectivesText: Speak with Lieutenant Doren.

332.name: Wine Shop Advert
objectivesText: Go to the Gallina Winery, and bring Suzetta Gallina the Wine Ticket for a free bottle of wine.

333.name: Harlan Needs a Resupply
objectivesText: Go to the Canal Tailor Shop and bring Rema Schneider the Cloth Request from Harlan Bagley.

334.name: Package for Thurman
objectivesText: Go to the Larson Clothiers in the Stormwind Mage Quarter, and give Thurman Schneider his Sewing Kit.

335.name: A Noble Brew
objectivesText: Zardeth the Black Claw wants you to bring him a Tear of Tilloa from Darkshire and a Musquash Root from the Wetlands.

336.name: A Noble Brew
objectivesText: Take the Black Claw Stout to Lord Wishock in the Hall of Petitioners.

337.name: An Old History Book
objectivesText: Return the book: The History of Stormwind, to the Stormwind Library.

338.name: The Green Hills of Stranglethorn
objectivesText: Collect the missing pages from The Green Hills of Stranglethorn manuscript. Once all four chapters are complete, return them to Barnil.

339.name: Chapter I
objectivesText: Bring pages 1, 4, 6, and 8 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter I.

340.name: Chapter II
objectivesText: Bring pages 10, 11, 14 and 16 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter II.

341.name: Chapter III
objectivesText: Bring pages 18, 20, 21and 24 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter III.

342.name: Chapter IV
objectivesText: Bring pages 25, 26, and 27 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter IV.

343.name: Speaking of Fortitude
objectivesText: Go to the Royal Library in Stormwind Keep and speak with Milton Sheaf. He can find for you the book on metallurgy that Brother Kristoff needs for his speech.

344.name: Brother Paxton
objectivesText: Speak with Brother Paxton in the Northshire Abbey.

345.name: Ink Supplies
objectivesText: Speak with Foreman Oslow in Lakeshire and ask him for Rethban Iron Ore.

346.name: Return to Kristoff
objectivesText: Return to Brother Kristoff in the Cathedral Square. Give him the book The Stresses of Iron.

347.name: Rethban Ore
objectivesText: Gather 5 loads of Rethban Ore and bring it to Brother Paxton in the Northshire Library.

348.name: Stranglethorn Fever
objectivesText: Seek out Witch Doctor Unbagwa and have him summon Mokk the Savage. Bring the Heart of Mokk to Fin Fizracket.

350.name: Look to an Old Friend
objectivesText: Speak to Elling Trias in Stormwind.

351.name: Find OOX-17/TN!
objectivesText: Bring the distress beacon to Oglethorpe's homing robot.

8543.name: The Horde Needs More Tin Bars!
objectivesText: Bring 20 tin bars to Grunt Maug in Durotar.

353.name: Stormpike's Delivery
objectivesText: Deliver the Package for Stormpike to Mountaineer Stormpike in Loch Modan.

354.name: Deaths in the Family
objectivesText: Bring Gregor's Remains, Nissa's Remains and Thurman's Remains to Coleman Farthing in Brill.

355.name: Speak with Sevren
objectivesText: Speak with Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

356.name: Rear Guard Patrol
objectivesText: Kill 8 Bleeding Horrors and 8 Wandering Spirits, then report back to Linnea at her camp.

357.name: The Lich's Identity
objectivesText: Bring the Lich's Spellbook to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

358.name: Graverobbers
objectivesText: Kill Rot Hide Graverobbers and Rot Hide Mongrels.
Bring 8 Embalming Ichors to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

359.name: Forsaken Duties
objectivesText: Speak with Deathguard Linnea.

360.name: Return to the Magistrate
objectivesText: Return to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

361.name: A Letter Undelivered
objectivesText: Find Yvette Farthing, and deliver to her the letter from Thurman Agamand.

362.name: The Haunted Mills
objectivesText: Slay Devlin Agamand, and bring Devlin's Remains to Coleman Farthing in Brill.

363.name: Rude Awakening
objectivesText: Speak with Shadow Priest Sarvis.

364.name: The Mindless Ones
objectivesText: Shadow Priest Sarvis wants you to kill 8 Mindless Zombies and 8 Wretched Zombies.

365.name: Fields of Grief
objectivesText: Steal 10 pumpkins from the farm to the west, just north of Deathknell and take them to Apothecary Johaan in Brill.

366.name: Return the Book
objectivesText: Return Gunther's Spellbook to him, on the island of Gunther's Retreat.

367.name: A New Plague
objectivesText: Apothecary Johaan in the town of Brill wants you to collect 5 Vials of Darkhound Blood.

368.name: A New Plague
objectivesText: Apothecary Johaan of the town of Brill needs 5 Vile Fin Scales from Murlocs in Tirisfal Glades.

369.name: A New Plague
objectivesText: Apothecary Johaan in the town of Brill wants you to bring him 4 samples of venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider.

370.name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
objectivesText: Executor Zygand in Brill wants you to kill Captain Perrine, 3 Scarlet Zealots and 3 Scarlet Missionaries.

371.name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
objectivesText: Executor Zygand in Brill has commissioned you to slay Captain Vachon and 5 Scarlet Friars.

372.name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
objectivesText: Executor Zygand in the town of Brill wants you to assassinate Captain Melrache and his two bodyguards.

373.name: The Unsent Letter
objectivesText: Deliver the Letter to the City Architect to Baros Alexston in Stormwind.

374.name: Proof of Demise
objectivesText: Bring 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings to Deathguard Burgess in Brill.

375.name: The Chill of Death
objectivesText: Bring five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread to Gretchen Dedmar in Brill.

376.name: The Damned
objectivesText: Novice Elreth requires 6 Scavenger Paws and 6 Duskbat Wings.

377.name: Crime and Punishment
objectivesText: Councilman Millstipe of Darkshire wants you to bring him the hand of Dextren Ward.

378.name: The Fury Runs Deep
objectivesText: Motley Garmason wants Kam Deepfury's head brought to him at Dun Modr.

379.name: Slake That Thirst
objectivesText: Bring 5 Wastewander Water Pouches to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.

380.name: Night Web's Hollow
objectivesText: Executor Arren wants you to kill 10 Young Night Web Spiders and 8 Night Web Spiders.

381.name: The Scarlet Crusade
objectivesText: Bring Executor Arren 12 Scarlet Armbands from Scarlet Converts and Scarlet Initiates.

382.name: The Red Messenger
objectivesText: Kill Meven Korgal, the messenger, at the Crusader camp, then return any information you find to Executor Arren.

383.name: Vital Intelligence
objectivesText: Deliver the Scarlet Crusade Documents to Executor Zygand in Brill.

384.name: Beer Basted Boar Ribs
objectivesText: Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos wants 6 Crag Boar Ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt.

385.name: Crocolisk Hunting
objectivesText: Get 5 pieces of Crocolisk Meat and 6 Crocolisk Skins for Marek Ironheart at the Farstrider Lodge.

386.name: What Comes Around...
objectivesText: Bring the head of Targorr the Dread to Guard Berton in Lakeshire.

387.name: Quell The Uprising
objectivesText: Warden Thelwater of Stormwind wants you to kill 10 Defias Prisoners, 8 Defias Convicts, and 8 Defias Insurgents in The Stockade.

388.name: The Color of Blood
objectivesText: Nikova Raskol of Stormwind wants you to collect 10 Red Wool Bandanas.

389.name: Bazil Thredd
objectivesText: Speak with Warden Thelwater in the Stockade.

8581.name: The Horde Needs More Firebloom!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Firebloom to Batrider Pele'keiki at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.

391.name: The Stockade Riots
objectivesText: Kill Bazil Thredd and bring his head back to Warden Thelwater at the Stockade.

392.name: The Curious Visitor
objectivesText: Bring the Sealed Description of Thredd's Visitor to Baros Alexston in Stormwind.

393.name: Shadow of the Past
objectivesText: Bring the Sealed Description of Thredd's Visitor to Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.

394.name: The Head of the Beast
objectivesText: Speak to Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.

395.name: Brotherhood's End
objectivesText: Speak with Baros Alexston in Stormwind.

396.name: An Audience with the King
objectivesText: Deliver Baros Alexston's report on the Defias Brotherhood to King Varian Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.

397.name: You Have Served Us Well
objectivesText: Speak with Zggi, the servant of Zardeth the Blackclaw, to claim your reward.

398.name: Wanted: Maggot Eye
objectivesText: Kill Maggot Eye and return to Executor Zygand in Brill with his paw for a reward.

399.name: Humble Beginnings
objectivesText: Go to Baros Alexston's house in Westfall and search for his compass, then return it to him in Cathedral Square of Stormwind.

400.name: Tools for Steelgrill
objectivesText: Deliver Steelgrill's Tools to Beldin Steelgrill.

401.name: Wait for Sirra to Finish
objectivesText: Wait a moment, then speak with Sirra Von'Indi again.

8593.name: Trousers of the Oracle
objectivesText: Bring Ouro's Intact Hide, 2 Idols of Life, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Kandrostrasz inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

404.name: A Putrid Task
objectivesText: Bring 7 Putrid Claws to Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.

405.name: The Prodigal Lich
objectivesText: Present Sevren's Orders to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

8597.name: Draconic for Dummies
objectivesText: Find Narain Soothfancy's book, buried on an island in the South Seas.

407.name: Fields of Grief
objectivesText: Take the Laced Pumpkin to the Captured Scarlet Zealot who is being held in the cellar of the Gallow's End Tavern.

408.name: The Family Crypt
objectivesText: Kill 8 Wailing Ancestors and 8 Rotting Ancestors.
Kill Captain Dargol, and bring his skull to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

409.name: Proving Allegiance
objectivesText: Obtain a Candle of Beckoning.
Summon Lillith Nefara and kill her.
Return to Gunther on his island.

411.name: The Prodigal Lich Returns
objectivesText: Bring the Nether Gem to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

412.name: Operation Recombobulation
objectivesText: Bring Razzle Sprysprocket in Kharanos 8 Restabilization Cogs and 8 Gyromechanic Gears.

413.name: Shimmer Stout
objectivesText: Take the Barrel of Shimmer Stout to Mountaineer Barleybrew.

414.name: Stout to Kadrell
objectivesText: Take the Cask of Shimmer Stout to Mountaineer Kadrell.

415.name: Rejold's New Brew
objectivesText: Speak with Rejold Barleybrew.

416.name: Rat Catching
objectivesText: Bring 12 Tunnel Rat Ears to Mountaineer Kadrell in Thelsamar.

417.name: A Pilot's Revenge
objectivesText: Kill Mangeclaw.
Bring his Mangy Claw and Hildelve's Journal to Pilot Hammerfoot.

418.name: Thelsamar Blood Sausages
objectivesText: Bring 3 pieces of Bear Meat, 3 Boar Intestines, and 3 Spider Ichor to Vidra Hearthstove in Thelsamar.

419.name: The Lost Pilot
objectivesText: Find Pilot Hildelve.

420.name: Senir's Observations
objectivesText: Deliver Grelin's report to Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.

421.name: Prove Your Worth
objectivesText: Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher wants you to kill 5 Moonrage Whitescalps.

422.name: Arugal's Folly
objectivesText: Retrieve the Remedy of Arugal for Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.

423.name: Arugal's Folly
objectivesText: Bring 6 Glutton Shackles and 3 Darksoul Shackles to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.

424.name: Arugal's Folly
objectivesText: Kill Grimson the Pale and bring his head to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.

425.name: Ivar the Foul
objectivesText: Kill Ivar the Foul, and bring Ivar's Head to Rane Yorick at the Ivar Patch.

426.name: The Mills Overrun
objectivesText: Gather 5 Notched Ribs and 3 Blackened Skulls, then return to Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.

427.name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
objectivesText: Executor Zygand of Brill wants you to kill 10 Scarlet Warriors.

428.name: Lost Deathstalkers
objectivesText: Find the Deathstalkers Quinn and Rane Yorick.

429.name: Wild Hearts
objectivesText: Gather 6 discolored worg hearts and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

430.name: Return to Quinn
objectivesText: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.

432.name: Those Blasted Troggs!
objectivesText: Kill 6 Rockjaw Skullthumpers for Foreman Stonebrow at the Gol'Bolar quarry.

433.name: The Public Servant
objectivesText: Kill 10 Rockjaw Bonesnappers for Senator Mehr Stonehallow at the Gol'Bolar quarry.

434.name: The Attack!
objectivesText: Remain in the garden until Lord Gregor Lescovar and Marzon the Silent Blade have had their conversation. Afterwards, kill them both before returning to Elling Trias in Stormwind.

435.name: Escorting Erland
objectivesText: Escort Erland through the wolves, to Rane Yorick.

436.name: Ironband's Excavation
objectivesText: Speak with Explorer Fellhew.

437.name: The Dead Fields
objectivesText: Kill rot hide gnolls at the Dead Fields.
When Nightlash appears, kill her.
Bring the Essence of Nightlash to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

438.name: The Decrepit Ferry
objectivesText: Go to the Decrepit Ferry.

* The ruby has been stashed in a barricaded Shadowforge area.
* The topaz has been hidden in an urn in one of the Trogg areas, near some Alliance dwarves.

These actions must be performed in the correct order, as Fizzule will attack and terminate any person he does not recognize.

objectivesText: Kill 10 Blood Elf Reclaimers, and 10 Blood Elf Surveyors before seeking out Magus Rimtori's camp. Once you've found it, look for something that might be important to her that can be used to draw her into a fight.

3506.name: Betrayed
objectivesText: Destroy the arcane focusing crystal tied to Magus Rimtori and then slay her. Afterwards, take the Head of Magus Rimtori to Ag'tor Bloodfist in Azshara.

3507.name: Betrayed
objectivesText: Speak to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.

3508.name: Breaking the Ward
objectivesText: Wait for Loramus to complete the enlightenment spell.

3509.name: The Name of the Beast
objectivesText: Speak with Lord Arkkoroc in Azshara. Begin your search at the waters edge to find the Temple of Arkkoran.

3510.name: The Name of the Beast
objectivesText: Slay Hetaera and bring back Hetaera's Bloodied Head, Hetaera's Beaten Head, and Hetaera's Bruised Head to Lord Arkkoroc.

3511.name: The Name of the Beast
objectivesText: Take the temper back to Loramus Thalipedes.

3512.name: In Eranikus' Own Words
objectivesText: Travel to the eastern part of Winterspring and speak with Umbranse the Spiritspeaker.

3513.name: The Runed Scroll
objectivesText: Take the Runed Scroll to the northern guard tower in the Barrens.

3514.name: Horde Presence
objectivesText: Kill the leader of the Talon Den, Rynthariel the Keymaster.

3517.name: Stealing Knowledge
objectivesText: Find the Tablet of Beth'Amara, the Tablet of Jin'yael, the Tablet of Markri, and the Tablet of Sael'hai before returning to Jediga in Azshara.

3518.name: Delivery to Magatha
objectivesText: Bring the Tablet of Beth'Amara to Magatha in Thunder Bluff.

3519.name: A Friend in Need
objectivesText: Speak to Dirania Silvershine in Shadowglen.

3520.name: Screecher Spirits
objectivesText: Capture the spirits of 3 screechers in Feralas, then return to Yeh'kinya in Steamwheedle Port.

3521.name: Iverron's Antidote
objectivesText: Collect 7 Hyacinth Mushrooms, 4 Moonpetal Lilies, and 1 Webwood Ichor for Dirania Silveshine in Shadowglen.

3522.name: Iverron's Antidote
objectivesText: Bring Iverron's Antidote to Iverron before the time limit is up. Iverron can be found by the cave to the north.

3523.name: Scourge of the Downs
objectivesText: If you agree to aid Belnistrasz, speak with him again and hand the Oathstone he gave you back to him.

3524.name: Washed Ashore
objectivesText: Recover Sea Creature Bones from the beached sea creature just south of Auberdine, and then return with it to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

3525.name: Extinguishing the Idol
objectivesText: Escort Belnistrasz to the Quilboar's idol in Razorfen Downs.
Protect Belnistrasz while he performs the ritual to shut down the idol.

3526.name: Goblin Engineering
objectivesText: If you wish to learn more about Goblin Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

3527.name: The Prophecy of Mosh'aru
objectivesText: Bring the First and Second Mosh'aru Tablets to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

3528.name: The God Hakkar
objectivesText: Bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

3541.name: Delivery to Jes'rimon
objectivesText: Bring the Tablet of Jin'yael to Jes'rimon in Orgrimmar.

3542.name: Delivery to Andron Gant
objectivesText: Bring the Tablet of Markri to Andron Gant in Undercity.

3561.name: Delivery to Archmage Xylem
objectivesText: Bring the Tablet of Sael'hai to Archmage Xylem in Azshara.

3562.name: Magatha's Payment to Jediga
objectivesText: Deliver Magatha's Note to Jediga in Azshara.

3563.name: Jes'rimon's Payment to Jediga
objectivesText: Deliver Jes'rimon's Note to Jediga in Azshara.

3564.name: Andron's Payment to Jediga
objectivesText: Deliver Andron's Note to Jediga in Azshara.

3565.name: Xylem's Payment to Jediga
objectivesText: Deliver Xylem's Note to Jediga in Azshara.

3566.name: Rise, Obsidion!
objectivesText: Slay Lathoric the Black and Obsidion, and return to Thorius in Ironforge with the Head of Lathoric the Black and the Heart of Obsidion.

3568.name: Seeping Corruption
objectivesText: Fill all 4 Empty Vials at the tide pools along the coast of the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara before returning to Chemist Cuely.

3569.name: Seeping Corruption
objectivesText: Give Cuely's Elixir to Thersa Windsong in Undercity.

3601.name: Kim'jael Indeed!
objectivesText: Search the Thalassian Base Camp for Kim'jael's Compass, Scope, Stuffed Chicken and Wizzlegoober, then return them to him in Azshara.

3602.name: Azsharite
objectivesText: Recover twenty Crystallized Azsharite from southern Azshara. You may use the Felhound to assist you in 'sniffing' out the location of cleverly hidden deposits.
Return to Loramus when the task is complete.

3621.name: The Formation of Felbane
objectivesText: Take the Shipment to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn Vale.

3625.name: Enchanted Azsharite Fel Weaponry
objectivesText: Wait for Galvan to finish forging the weaponry.

3626.name: Return to the Blasted Lands
objectivesText: Return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

3627.name: Uniting the Shattered Amulet
objectivesText: Slay Grol the Destroyer, Lady Sevine, and Archmage Allistarj. From their corpses take the Amulet of Grol, the Amulet of Sevine, and the Amulet of Allistarj.
Remember to USE your Enchanted Azsharite Fel Weaponry to weaken the triad. They cannot be killed otherwise - but use them wisely...

3628.name: You Are Rakh'likh, Demon
objectivesText: Destroy Razelikh the Defiler and return the Severed Horn of the Defiler to the Fallen Hero of the Horde. You will also need to return the Ward of the Defiler so that the Fallen Hero can destroy it, preventing it from ever falling into the wrong hands.

3629.name: Goblin Engineering
objectivesText: If you wish to learn more about Goblin Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

3630.name: Gnome Engineering
objectivesText: If you wish to learn more about Gnome Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.

3631.name: Summon Felsteed
objectivesText: Speak to Strahad Farsan in the Barrens.

3632.name: Gnome Engineering
objectivesText: If you wish to learn more about Gnome Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.

3633.name: Goblin Engineering
objectivesText: If you wish to learn more about Goblin Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

3634.name: Gnome Engineering
objectivesText: If you wish to learn more about Gnome Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.

3635.name: Gnome Engineering
objectivesText: If you wish to learn more about Gnome Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.

3636.name: Bring the Light
objectivesText: Archbishop Bendictus wants you to slay Amnennar the Coldbringer in Razorfen Downs.

3637.name: Gnome Engineering
objectivesText: If you wish to learn more about Gnome Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.

3638.name: The Pledge of Secrecy
objectivesText: If you agree to become a Goblin Engineer, then right-click on the Pledge of Secrecy and speak once more with Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

3639.name: Show Your Work
objectivesText: Bring 20 Big Iron Bombs, 20 Solid Dynamite, and 5 Explosive Sheep to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

3640.name: The Pledge of Secrecy
objectivesText: If you agree to become a Gnome Engineer, then right-click on the Pledge of Secrecy and speak once more with Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.

3641.name: Show Your Work
objectivesText: Bring 6 Mithril Tubes, an Accurate Scope, and 2 Advanced Target Dummies to Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.

3642.name: The Pledge of Secrecy
objectivesText: If you agree to become a Gnome Engineer, then right-click on the Pledge of Secrecy and speak once more with Oglethrope Obnoticus in Booty bay.

3643.name: Show Your Work
objectivesText: Bring 6 Mithril Tubes, an Accurate Scope, and a 2 Advanced Target Dummies to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.

3661.name: Favored of Elune?
objectivesText: Collect 15 Wildkin Feathers from the Hinterlands for Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.

3681.name: Tome of Divinity
objectivesText: Speak with Duthorian Rall in Stormwind.

3701.name: The Smoldering Ruins of Thaurissan
objectivesText: Venture to the Ruins of Thaurissan in the Burning Steppes and recover information from the Thaurissan Relics. Return to Royal Historian Archesonus when you have recovered the information.

3702.name: The Smoldering Ruins of Thaurissan
objectivesText: Listen to Royal Historian Archesonus recant the history of Thaurissan.

3741.name: Hilary's Necklace
objectivesText: Find Hilary's Necklace, and return it to Hilary in Lakeshire.

3761.name: Un'Goro Soil
objectivesText: Bring 20 Un'Goro Soil samples to Ghede on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.

3762.name: Assisting Arch Druid Runetotem
objectivesText: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

3763.name: Assisting Arch Druid Staghelm
objectivesText: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

3764.name: Un'Goro Soil
objectivesText: Bring 20 Un'Goro Soil samples to Jenal at the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus.

3765.name: The Corruption Abroad
objectivesText: Travel to Gershala Nightwhisper in Auberdine.

3781.name: Morrowgrain Research
objectivesText: Take the Arch Druid's Seed Voucher to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus.

3782.name: Morrowgrain Research
objectivesText: Take the Seed Voucher to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

3783.name: Are We There, Yeti?
objectivesText: Collect 10 Thick Yeti Furs for Umi Rumplesnicker in Everlook.

3784.name: Assisting Arch Druid Runetotem
objectivesText: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

3785.name: Morrowgrain Research
objectivesText: Use an Evergreen Pouch with a Packet of Tharlendis Seeds and two Un'Goro Soil samples to try and cultivate samples of Morrowgrain.
Bring 10 Morrowgrain to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus.

3786.name: Morrowgrain Research
objectivesText: Use an Evergreen Pouch with a Packet of Tharlendis Seeds and two Un'Goro Soil samples to try and cultivate samples of Morrowgrain.
Bring 10 Morrowgrain to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

3787.name: Jonespyre's Request
objectivesText: Speak with Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.

3788.name: Jonespyre's Request
objectivesText: Speak with Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.

3789.name: Assisting Arch Druid Staghelm
objectivesText: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

3790.name: Assisting Arch Druid Staghelm
objectivesText: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

3791.name: The Mystery of Morrowgrain
objectivesText: Bring 10 Morrowgrain to Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.

3801.name: Dark Iron Legacy
objectivesText: Speak with Franclorn Forgewright if you are interested in obtaining a key to the city major.

3802.name: Dark Iron Legacy
objectivesText: Slay Fineous Darkvire and recover the great hammer, Ironfel. Take Ironfel to the Shrine of Thaurissan and place it on the statue of Franclorn Forgewright.

3821.name: Dreadmaul Rock
objectivesText: Venture forth to the Burning Steppes and find out what became of Sha'ni Proudtusk.

3822.name: Krom'Grul
objectivesText: Recover Sha'ni's Nose-Ring from Krom'Grul and return it to Thal'trak in Kargath. Search the various caves and mines in Dreadmaul Rock.

3823.name: Extinguish the Firegut
objectivesText: Slay 15 Firegut Ogre-Mages, 7 Firegut Ogres, and 7 Firegut Ogre Brutes, and return to Oralius when you are finished.

3824.name: Gor'tesh the Brute Lord
objectivesText: Find Gor'tesh, somewhere to the west of Dreadmaul Rock. Kill Gor'tesh and then take Gor'tesh's Lopped Off Head back to Oralius in Burning Steppes.

3825.name: Ogre Head On A Stick = Party
objectivesText: Take Gor'tesh's Lopped Off Head and place it at the top of Dreadmaul Rock. Look for a soft dirt mound to plant the pike.

3841.name: An Orphan Looking For a Home
objectivesText: Speak to Quentin in Thousand Needles.

3842.name: A Short Incubation
objectivesText: Bring 2 Elixir of Fortitudes to Quentin in Thousand Needles.

3843.name: The Newest Member of the Family
objectivesText: Take your Fragile Sprite Darter Egg to the Hinterlands and speak to Agnar Beastamer, but hurry, you only have 1 hour to find him before the hatchling within the egg dies.

3844.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
objectivesText: Look around in the pond for a clue about who this wrecked raft may belong to.

3845.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
objectivesText: Examine the items inside the pack and bring them to their owner.

3861.name: CLUCK!
objectivesText: Find some Special Chicken Feed and return to your befriended chicken. When you find it, /cheer at it before trying to give it the Special Chicken Feed.

3881.name: Expedition Salvation
objectivesText: Bring a Crate of Foodstuffs and Research Equipment to Williden Marshal in Un'Goro Crater.

3882.name: Roll the Bones
objectivesText: Bring 8 Dinosaur Bones to Spark Nilminer in Un'Goro Crater.

3883.name: Alien Ecology
objectivesText: Use the Scraping Vial to collect a Hive Wall Sample from one of the Gorishi hive hatcheries in Un'Goro Crater. Look for the chambers with the hanging larval spawns.
Bring the Hive Wall Sample to Hol'anyee Marshal in Un'Goro Crater.

3884.name: Williden's Journal
objectivesText: Return the journal to Williden Marshal somewhere in Un'Goro Crater.

3901.name: Rattling the Rattlecages
objectivesText: Kill 12 Rattlecage Skeletons, and then return to Shadow Priest Sarvis in Deathknell when you are done.

3902.name: Scavenging Deathknell
objectivesText: Search Deathknell and the vicinity for 6 pieces of Scavenged Goods, and return them to Deathguard Saltain.

3903.name: Milly Osworth
objectivesText: Speak with Milly Osworth.

3904.name: Milly's Harvest
objectivesText: Bring 8 crates of Milly's Harvest to Milly Osworth at Northshire Abbey.

3905.name: Grape Manifest
objectivesText: Bring the Grape Manifest to Brother Neals in Northshire Abbey.

3906.name: Disharmony of Flame
objectivesText: Travel to the quarry in Blackrock Mountain and slay Overmaster Pyron. Return to Thunderheart when you have completed this assignment.

3907.name: Disharmony of Fire
objectivesText: Enter Blackrock Depths and track down Lord Incendius. Slay him and return any source of information you may find to Thunderheart.

3908.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
objectivesText: Take Linken's Sword to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

3909.name: The Videre Elixir
objectivesText: Seek out Gregan Brewspewer in northern Feralas. From him, learn how you may acquire the Videre Elixir, then return to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

3912.name: Meet at the Grave
objectivesText: Go to the graveyard outside Gadgetzan, and use the Videre Elixir. Follow the rest of Donova's instructions to find Gaeriyan.

3913.name: A Grave Situation
objectivesText: Resurrect, then look for the gravestone that Gaeriyan told you to find.

3914.name: Linken's Sword
objectivesText: Deliver Linken's Superior Sword to Linken in Un'Goro Crater.

3921.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
objectivesText: Bring the Broken Samophlange to Wenikee Boltbucket.

3922.name: Nugget Slugs
objectivesText: Bring 15 Nugget Slugs to Wenikee Boltbucket in the Barrens.

3923.name: Rilli Greasygob
objectivesText: Bring the Broken and Battered Samophlange to Rilli Greasygob in Orgrimmar.

3924.name: Samophlange Manual
objectivesText: Bring the Samophlange Manual to Rilli Greasygob in Orgrimmar.

3941.name: A Gnome's Assistance
objectivesText: Find J.D. Collie in the cave at Marshal's Refuge.

3942.name: Linken's Memory
objectivesText: Find Eridan Bluewind in southern Felwood.

3961.name: Linken's Adventure
objectivesText: Take the Silver Totem of Aquementas to Linken in Marshal's Refuge.

3962.name: It's Dangerous to Go Alone
objectivesText: Travel to Fire Plume Ridge, south of Marshal's Refuge.
Find Blazerunner and use the totem to remove his protective aura. Once he has been defeated, acquire the Golden Flame from the cave.

3981.name: Commander Gor'shak
objectivesText: Find Commander Gor'shak in Blackrock Depths.
You recall that the crudely drawn picture of the orc included bars drawn over the portrait. Perhaps you should search for a prison of some sort.

3982.name: What Is Going On?
objectivesText: Defend Gor'shak.

4001.name: What Is Going On?
objectivesText: Speak with Kharan Mighthammer and gather information about Princess Moira Bronzebeard's kidnapping. Take that information to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
You recall Gor'shak mentioning that Kharan is being held in a cell nearby.

4002.name: The Eastern Kingdom
objectivesText: Speak with Thrall if you are prepared to take on the mission he has planned.

4003.name: The Royal Rescue
objectivesText: Slay Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and free Princess Moira Bronzebeard from his evil spell.

4004.name: The Princess Saved?
objectivesText: Return to Thrall!

4005.name: Aquementas
objectivesText: Take the Book of Aquor, the Silvery Claws, and the Irontree Heart to Tanaris.
Use the Book of Aquor to summon Aquementas.
After you have the completed totem, take it to J.D. Collie in Marshal's Refuge.

4021.name: Counterattack!
objectivesText: Bring a Piece of Krom'zar's Banner to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.

4022.name: A Taste of Flame
objectivesText: Show Cyrus Therepentous the Black Dragonflight Molt you received from Kalaran Windblade.

4023.name: A Taste of Flame
objectivesText: Show Cyrus Therepentous proof of your worth.
You have a feeling that Cyrus already knows that you are unworthy.

4024.name: A Taste of Flame
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay Bael'Gar.
You only know that the giant resides inside Blackrock Depths. Remember to use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on Bael'Gar's remains to capture the Fiery Essence.
Return the Encased Fiery Essence to Cyrus Therepentous.

4061.name: The Rise of the Machines
objectivesText: Venture to the Burning Steppes and recover 10 Fractured Elemental Shards for Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania.
You recall Theodora mentioning the golems and elementals of that region as being a source for these shards.

4062.name: The Rise of the Machines
objectivesText: Take the Elemental Shard Sample to Lotwil Veriatus.
You recall Theodora saying that Lotwil was stationed in a camp to the east.

4063.name: The Rise of the Machines
objectivesText: Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach. You know this because you are psychic.

4081.name: KILL ON SIGHT: Dark Iron Dwarves
objectivesText: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors!
Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 15 Anvilrage Guardsmen, 10 Anvilrage Wardens and 5 Anvilrage Footmen. Return to him once your task is complete.

4082.name: KILL ON SIGHT: High Ranking Dark Iron Officials
objectivesText: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors!
Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 10 Anvilrage Medics, 10 Anvilrage Soldiers and 10 Anvilrage Officers. Return to him once your task is complete.

4084.name: Silver Heart
objectivesText: Collect 11 Silvery Claws and 1 Irontree Heart for Eridan Bluewind in Felwood.

4101.name: Cleansing Felwood
objectivesText: Bring 15 Blood Amber to Arathandris Silversky in Felwood.

4102.name: Cleansing Felwood
objectivesText: Bring 15 Blood Amber to Maybess Riverbreeze in Felwood.

4120.name: The Strength of Corruption
objectivesText: Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas wants you to kill 12 Angerclaw Grizzlies and 12 Felpaw Ravagers in Felwood.

4121.name: Precarious Predicament
objectivesText: Escort your prisoner, Grark Lorkrub, through Burning Steppes and through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge.
You recall Lexlort mentioning that he would have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.
You will also be required to hand over your Thorium Shackles to Lexlort.

4122.name: Grark Lorkrub
objectivesText: Travel to the Burning Steppes and find Grark Lorkrub. You recall Lexlort mentioning that he was last seen in a massive Blackrock fortress.

When you find Grark Lorkrub, use the Thorium Shackles to bind him and then lead him back through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge. Lexlort will have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.

4123.name: The Heart of the Mountain
objectivesText: Bring the Heart of the Mountain to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.

4124.name: The Missing Courier
objectivesText: Speak with Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.

4125.name: The Missing Courier
objectivesText: Locate the courier's boat somewhere along the coast of Feralas.

4126.name: Hurley Blackbreath
objectivesText: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos.

4127.name: Boat Wreckage
objectivesText: Return to Feathermoon Stronghold and show Ginro Hearthkindle the Discarded Knife you have found.

4128.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
objectivesText: Speak with Ragnar Thunderbrew.

4129.name: The Knife Revealed
objectivesText: Take the Discarded Knife to Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.

4130.name: Psychometric Reading
objectivesText: Speak with Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.

4131.name: The Woodpaw Gnolls
objectivesText: Search the Woodpaw Gnoll camps of southern Feralas for evidence of the courier's belongings or the courier himself.

4132.name: Operation: Death to Angerforge
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay General Angerforge! Return to Warlord Goretooth when the task is complete.

4133.name: Vivian Lagrave
objectivesText: Speak with Shadowmaster Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

4134.name: Lost Thunderbrew Recipe
objectivesText: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

4135.name: The Writhing Deep
objectivesText: Now that Raschal's last known whereabouts have been discovered, continue your search for him or his remains in the Writhing Deep. According to the note, it is located to the south of the Woodpaw gnoll camps.

4136.name: Ribbly Screwspigot
objectivesText: Bring Ribbly's Head to Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.

4141.name: Muigin and Larion
objectivesText: Collect 15 Bloodpetals and return to Muigin.

4142.name: A Visit to Gregan
objectivesText: Take a Bloodpetal to Gregan Brewspewer in Feralas.

4143.name: Haze of Evil
objectivesText: Collect 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze, then return to Muigin in Un'Goro Crater.

4145.name: Larion and Muigin
objectivesText: Hunt 5 Bloodpetal Lashers, 5 Bloodpetal Threshers, 5 Bloodpetal Flayers and 5 Bloodpetal Trappers for Larion at Marshal's Refuge.

4146.name: Zapper Fuel
objectivesText: Deliver the Unloaded Zapper and 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze to Larion in Marshal's Refuge.

4147.name: Marvon's Workshop
objectivesText: Travel to Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.

4161.name: Recipe of the Kaldorei
objectivesText: Collect 7 Small Spider Legs for Zarrin in Dolanaar.

4181.name: Goblin Engineering
objectivesText: If you wish to learn more about Goblin Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

4182.name: Dragonkin Menace
objectivesText: Slay 15 Black Broodlings, 10 Black Dragonspawn, 4 Black Wyrmkin and 1 Black Drake. Return to Helendis Riverhorn when the task is complete.

4183.name: The True Masters
objectivesText: Travel to Lakeshire and deliver Helendis Riverhorn's Letter to Magistrate Solomon.

4184.name: The True Masters
objectivesText: Travel to Stormwind and deliver Solomon's Plea to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon.
Bolvar resides in Stormwind Keep.

4185.name: The True Masters
objectivesText: Speak with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon after speaking with Lady Katrana Prestor.

4186.name: The True Masters
objectivesText: Take Bolvar's Decree to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.

4201.name: The Love Potion
objectivesText: Bring 4 Gromsblood, 10 Giant Silver Veins and Nagmara's Filled Vial to Mistress Nagmara in Blackrock Depths.

4223.name: The True Masters
objectivesText: Speak with Marshal Maxwell in the Burning Steppes.

4224.name: The True Masters
objectivesText: Speak with Ragged John to learn of Marshal Windsor's fate and return to Marshal Maxwell when you have completed this task.
You recall Marshal Maxwell telling you to search for him in a cave to the north.

4241.name: Marshal Windsor
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Mountain in the northwest and enter Blackrock Depths. Find out what became of Marshal Windsor.
You recall Ragged John talking about Windsor being dragged off to a prison.

4242.name: Abandoned Hope
objectivesText: Give Marshal Maxwell the bad news.

4243.name: Chasing A-Me 01
objectivesText: Find A-Me 01 in Un'Goro Crater.

4244.name: Chasing A-Me 01
objectivesText: Find a Mithril Casing and return to A-Me 01 in Un'Goro Crater.

4245.name: Chasing A-Me 01
objectivesText: Escort A-Me 01 back to Karna Remtravel in Un'Goro Crater.

4261.name: Ancient Spirit
objectivesText: Escort Arei to safety, then speak with Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song, in eastern Ashenvale.

4262.name: Overmaster Pyron
objectivesText: Slay Overmaster Pyron and return to Jalinda Sprig.
You recall Jalinda talking about Pyron guarding the quarry. Perhaps you should search there?

4263.name: Incendius!
objectivesText: Find Lord Incendius in Blackrock Depths and destroy him!

4264.name: A Crumpled Up Note
objectivesText: You may have just stumbled on to something that Marshal Windsor would be interested in seeing. There may be hope, after all.

4265.name: Freed from the Hive
objectivesText: Free Raschal from the Zukk'ash hive.
Return to Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold and let him know that Raschal is alive and well.

4266.name: A Hero's Welcome
objectivesText: Speak with Shandris Feathermoon in Feathermoon Stronghold.

4267.name: Rise of the Silithid
objectivesText: Bring Raschal's Report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.

4281.name: Thalanaar Delivery
objectivesText: Bring the Undelivered Parcel to Falfindel Waywarder in Thalanaar.

4282.name: A Shred of Hope
objectivesText: Return Marshal Windsor's Lost Information.
Marshal Windsor believes that the information is being held by Golem Lord Argelmach and General Angerforge.

4283.name: FIFTY! YEP!
objectivesText: Oralius wants 50 Blackrock Medallions. Chances are high that these medallions can be found on the orcs in the Burning Steppes.

4284.name: Crystals of Power
objectivesText: Collect 7 Power Crystals of each color: red, blue, yellow, and green. Bring them to J.D. Collie at Marshal's Refuge.

4285.name: The Northern Pylon
objectivesText: Discover the location of the Northern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater.

4286.name: The Good Stuff
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 20 Dark Iron Fanny Packs. Return to Oralius when you have completed this task. You assume that the Dark Iron dwarves inside Blackrock Depths carry these 'fanny pack' contraptions.

4287.name: The Eastern Pylon
objectivesText: Discover the location of the Eastern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater.

4288.name: The Western Pylon
objectivesText: Discover the location of the Western Crystal Pylon.

4289.name: The Apes of Un'Goro
objectivesText: Bring 2 Un'Goro Gorilla Pelts, 2 Un'Goro Stomper Pelts, and 2 Un'Goro Thunderer Pelts to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un'Goro Crater.

4290.name: The Fare of Lar'korwi
objectivesText: Find the carcass of Lar'korwi's freshest kill and steal a Piece of Threshadon Carcass before returning to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.

4291.name: The Scent of Lar'korwi
objectivesText: Bring 2 Ravasaur Pheromone Glands to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.

4292.name: The Bait for Lar'korwi
objectivesText: Using the contents of Torwa's Pouch, summon Lar'korwi and defeat him. Then bring Lar'korwi's Head to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.

4293.name: A Sample of Slime...
objectivesText: Gather Felwood Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Felwood. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most corrupt. Bring 5 of the Corrupted Felwood Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.

4294.name: ... and a Batch of Ooze
objectivesText: Gather Un'Goro Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Un'Goro Crater. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most pure. Bring 5 of the Pure Un'Goro Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.

4296.name: Tablet of the Seven
objectivesText: Bring the Tablet Transcript to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.

4297.name: Food for Baby
objectivesText: Bring 5 Silvermane Stalker Flanks to Agnar Beastamer in Hinterlands.

4298.name: Becoming a Parent
objectivesText: Speak to Agnar Beastamer in the Hinterlands.

4300.name: Bone-Bladed Weapons
objectivesText: Bring 8 White Ravasaur Claws to Jes'rimon in Orgrimmar.

4301.name: The Mighty U'cha
objectivesText: Bring U'cha's Pelt to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un'Goro Crater.

4321.name: Making Sense of It
objectivesText: Speak with J.D. Collie in a moment.

4322.name: Jail Break!
objectivesText: Help Marshal Windsor get his gear back and free his friends. Return to Marshal Maxwell if you succeed.

4324.name: Yuka Screwspigot
objectivesText: Speak with Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.

4341.name: Kharan Mighthammer
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Depths and find Kharan Mighthammer.
The King mentioned that Kharan was being held prisoner there - perhaps you should try looking for a prison.

4342.name: Kharan's Tale
objectivesText: Listen as Kharan Mighthammer tells his story.

4361.name: The Bearer of Bad News
objectivesText: Return to Ironforge and deliver the bad news to King Magni Bronzebeard.

4362.name: The Fate of the Kingdom
objectivesText: Return to Blackrock Depths and rescue Princess Moira Bronzebeard from the evil clutches of Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.

4363.name: The Princess's Surprise
objectivesText: Return to Ironforge and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard.

4402.name: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise
objectivesText: Bring Galgar 10 Cactus Apples. You remember him saying that they could be found near cactuses.

4421.name: The Corruption of the Jadefire
objectivesText: Kill 11 Jadefire Felsworns, 9 Jadefire Shadowstalkers, 9 Jadefire Rogues, and Xavathras. Return to Eridan Bluewind in Felwood when the task has been completed.

4441.name: Felbound Ancients
objectivesText: Travel to Darnassus and use Eridan's Vial to collect a Vial of Blessed Water from the Temple of the Moon. Return to Eridan with the filled vial.

4442.name: Purified!
objectivesText: Speak to Eridan again in a moment.

4449.name: Caught!
objectivesText: Kill 8 Dark Iron Geologists and bring 15 pieces of Silk Cloth to the person locked in the outhouse in Searing Gorge.

4450.name: Ledger from Tanaris
objectivesText: Take the copy of Goodsteel's Ledger and then find the items listed in it before seeking Krinkle Goodsteel in Tanaris.

4451.name: The Key to Freedom
objectivesText: Search Searing Gorge and find a use for the Grimesilt Outhouse Key you have found.

4485.name: The Tome of Nobility
objectivesText: Speak to Duthorian Rall in Stormwind.

4486.name: The Tome of Nobility
objectivesText: Speak to Duthorian Rall in Stormwind.

4487.name: Summon Felsteed
objectivesText: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.

4488.name: Summon Felsteed
objectivesText: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.

4489.name: Summon Felsteed
objectivesText: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.

4490.name: Summon Felsteed
objectivesText: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet to learn the ability to summon a Felsteed.

4491.name: A Little Help From My Friends
objectivesText: Lead Ringo to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge.
If Ringo faints, use Spraggle's Canteen to revive him.

4492.name: Lost!
objectivesText: Find Ringo at Fire Plume Ridge.

4493.name: March of the Silithid
objectivesText: Speak to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

4494.name: March of the Silithid
objectivesText: Speak to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

4495.name: A Good Friend
objectivesText: Find Iverron by the cave to the north.

4496.name: Bungle in the Jungle
objectivesText: Bring a Gorishi Scent Gland and 5 Un'Goro Soil samples to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

4501.name: Beware of Pterrordax
objectivesText: Kill 10 Pterrordax and 15 Frenzied Pterrordax, then speak to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge.

4502.name: Volcanic Activity
objectivesText: Collect 9 samples of Un'Goro Ash from the fire elementals around the volcano in Un'Goro Crater, and return them to Liv Rizzlefix in Ratchet.

4503.name: Shizzle's Flyer
objectivesText: Collect 8 Webbed Diemetradon Scales and 8 Webbed Pterrordax Scales for Shizzle in Marshal's Refuge.

4504.name: Super Sticky
objectivesText: Collect 12 samples of Super Sticky Tar for Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.

4505.name: Well of Corruption
objectivesText: Collect a sample of corrupted water from the Jadefire Satyrs' moonwell and bring it to Winna Hazzard at Bloodvenom Post.

4506.name: Corrupted Sabers
objectivesText: Take Winna's kitten to the corrupted moonwell, release it, then bring it back to Winna.
Once you have returned to Winna, click on the cat to release it to Winna.

4507.name: Pawn Captures Queen
objectivesText: Defeat the Gorishi Hive Queen once she is summoned.
Bring the Gorishi Queen's Brain to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

4508.name: Calm Before the Storm
objectivesText: Bring Pestlezugg's Un'Goro Report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.

4509.name: Calm Before the Storm
objectivesText: Bring Pestlezugg's Un'Goro Report to Zilzibin Drumlore in Orgrimmar.

4510.name: Calm Before the Storm
objectivesText: Bring the Bank Voucher to Idriana in the bank of Darnassus.

4511.name: Calm Before the Storm
objectivesText: Bring the Bank Voucher to Karus in the bank of Orgrimmar.

4512.name: A Little Slime Goes a Long Way
objectivesText: Bring 6 Filled Cursed Ooze Jars and 6 Filled Tainted Ooze Jars to Laris Geardawdle in Ironforge.

4513.name: A Little Slime Goes a Long Way
objectivesText: Bring 10 Filled Pure Sample Jars to Laris Geardawdle in Ironforge.
If you have trouble finding them, perhaps try to get more clues from Laris.

4521.name: Wild Guardians
objectivesText: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to kill 15 Raging Owlbeasts and 15 Ragged Owlbeasts.

4542.name: Message to Freewind Post
objectivesText: Bring the Urgent Message to Cliffwatcher Longhorn at Freewind Post.

4581.name: Kayneth Stillwind
objectivesText: Take Shindrell's Note to Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song.

4601.name: The Sparklematic 5200!
objectivesText: Insert a Grime-Encrusted Item into the Sparklematic 5200, and be sure to have three silver coins to start the machine.

4602.name: The Sparklematic 5200!
objectivesText: Insert a Grime-Encrusted Item into the Sparklematic 5200, and be sure to have three silver coins to start the machine.

4621.name: Avast Ye, Admiral!
objectivesText: Slay Fleet Master Seahorn and Baron Revilgaz of Booty Bay, and then return to Fleet Master Firallon aboard the Crimson Veil off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale.

4641.name: Your Place In The World
objectivesText: Speak with Gornek. You recall Kaltunk marking your map with his location and mentioning that Gornek resided in the Den, a building to the west.

4642.name: Melding of Influences
objectivesText: Bring a Merged Ooze Sample to Chemist Fuely in Undercity.

4681.name: Washed Ashore
objectivesText: Recover the Sea Turtle Remains from the Skeletal Sea Turtle in the waters west of Auberdine, and then speak with Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde back in Auberdine.

4701.name: Put Her Down
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy the source of the worg menace. As you left Helendis, he shouted a name: Halycon. It is what the orcs refer to in regards to the worg.

4721.name: Wild Guardians
objectivesText: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 10 Berserk Owlbeasts in Winterspring.

4722.name: Beached Sea Turtle
objectivesText: Take the Sea Turtle Remains to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

4723.name: Beached Sea Creature
objectivesText: Take the Sea Creature Bones to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

4724.name: The Pack Mistress
objectivesText: Slay Halycon, pack mistress of the Bloodaxe worg.

4725.name: Beached Sea Turtle
objectivesText: Take the Strangely Marked Box to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

4726.name: Broodling Essence
objectivesText: Bring 8 Broodling Essence and the Draco-Incarcinatrix 900 to Tinkee Steamboil at the Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

4727.name: Beached Sea Turtle
objectivesText: Take the Sea Turtle Remains to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

4728.name: Beached Sea Creature
objectivesText: Take the Sea Creature Bones to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

4729.name: Kibler's Exotic Pets
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Bloodaxe Worg Pups. Use the cage to carry the ferocious little beasts. Bring back a Caged Worg Pup to Kibler.

4730.name: Beached Sea Creature
objectivesText: Take the Sea Creature Bones to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

4731.name: Beached Sea Turtle
objectivesText: Take the Strangely Marked Box to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

4732.name: Beached Sea Turtle
objectivesText: Take the Sea Turtle Remains to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

4733.name: Beached Sea Creature
objectivesText: Take the Sea Creature Bones to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

4734.name: Egg Freezing
objectivesText: Use the Eggscilloscope Prototype on an egg in the Rookery.

4735.name: Egg Collection
objectivesText: Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the Collectronic Module to Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

4736.name: In Search of Menara Voidrender
objectivesText: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4737.name: In Search of Menara Voidrender
objectivesText: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4738.name: In Search of Menara Voidrender
objectivesText: Speak with Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4739.name: In Search of Menara Voidrender
objectivesText: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4740.name: WANTED: Murkdeep!
objectivesText: Find and slay the murloc known as Murkdeep. The creature is thought to be defending the murloc huts south of Auberdine along the water.
Report the death of Murkdeep to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

4741.name: Wild Guardians
objectivesText: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 13 Moontouched Owlbeasts.

4742.name: Seal of Ascension
objectivesText: Find the three gemstones of command: The Gemstone of Smolderthorn, Gemstone of Spirestone, and Gemstone of Bloodaxe. Return them, along with the Unadorned Seal of Ascension, to Vaelan.
The Generals, as told to you by Vaelan, are: War Master Voone of the Smolderthorn; Highlord Omokk of the Spirestone; and Overlord Wyrmthalak of the Bloodaxe.

4743.name: Seal of Ascension
objectivesText: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh. Find the ancient drake, Emberstrife and beat him without mercy until his will is broken.

It is at that moment which you must place the Unforged Seal of Ascension before the great beast. You must then be quick to use the Orb of Draconic Energy on his weakened form and claim dominion over his mental faculties. Control the beast and force the Flames of the Black Dragonflight upon the Unforged Seal of Ascension!

4761.name: Thundris Windweaver
objectivesText: Speak with Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine.

4762.name: The Cliffspring River
objectivesText: Travel north of Auberdine to the first waterfall along the Cliffspring River and draw a sample from the pool there.
Return to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine with the Cliffspring River Sample.

4763.name: The Blackwood Corrupted
objectivesText: Fill the Empty Cleansing Bowl at the Auberdine Moonwell.
Gather a sample of fruit, nut, and grain from the northern Blackwood furbolg camps.
Mix the bowl and place it near the bonfire closest to the Cliffspring River at the northern camp, thus summoning the satyr corruptor.
Take the Talisman of Corruption and bring it to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine.

4764.name: Doomrigger's Clasp
objectivesText: Bring Doomrigger's Clasp to Mayara Brightwing in the Burning Steppes.

4765.name: Delivery to Ridgewell
objectivesText: Bring Ridgewell's Crate to Remington Ridgewell in Stormwind.

4766.name: Mayara Brightwing
objectivesText: Speak with Mayara Brightwing in the Burning Steppes.

4767.name: Wind Rider
objectivesText: Bring 10 Highperch Wyvern Eggs to Elu in Freewind Post.

4768.name: The Darkstone Tablet
objectivesText: Bring the Darkstone Tablet to Shadow Mage Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

4769.name: Vivian Lagrave and the Darkstone Tablet
objectivesText: Speak with Shadowmage Vivian Lagrave.

4770.name: Homeward Bound
objectivesText: Escort Pao'ka Swiftmountain from Highperch, and then talk to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post.

4771.name: Dawn's Gambit
objectivesText: Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room of the Scholomance. Defeat Vectus, then return to Betina Bigglezink.

4781.name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
objectivesText: Bring a Gold Bar to Xizk Goodstitch in Stranglethorn Vale.

4782.name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
objectivesText: Return to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4783.name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
objectivesText: Bring 10 Vials of Hatefury Blood and 1 Lesser Infernal Stone to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4784.name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
objectivesText: Bring some Fine Gold Thread, 2 Smoldering Coals, and a Soul Shard to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4786.name: The Completed Robe
objectivesText: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete your robe and then speak to her again.

4787.name: The Ancient Egg
objectivesText: Bring the Ancient Egg to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

4788.name: The Final Tablets
objectivesText: Bring the Fifth and Sixth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

4808.name: Felnok Steelspring
objectivesText: Give Tinkee's Letter to Felnok Steelspring.

4809.name: Chillwind Horns
objectivesText: Bring 8 Uncracked Chillwind Horns to Felnok Steelspring.

4810.name: Return to Tinkee
objectivesText: Bring Felnok's Package to Tinkee Steamboil in the Burning Steppes.

4811.name: The Red Crystal
objectivesText: Travel east of Auberdine and look for a large, red crystal along Darkshore's eastern mountain range. Report back what you find to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

4812.name: As Water Cascades
objectivesText: Fill the Empty Water Tube at the Auberdine moonwell, and then investigate the red crystal along Darkshore's eastern mountain wall.

4813.name: The Fragments Within
objectivesText: Report back what you have found to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

4821.name: Alien Egg
objectivesText: Return the Alien Egg to Hagar Lightninghoof in Freewind Post.

4822.name: You Scream, I Scream...
objectivesText: Get some Strawberry Ice Cream for your ward. The lad seems to prefer Tigule's brand ice cream.

4841.name: Pacify the Centaur
objectivesText: Kill 12 Galak Scouts, 10 Galak Wranglers, and 6 Galak Windchasers, and then return to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.

4842.name: Strange Sources
objectivesText: Follow Donova Snowden's instructions, then report back.

4861.name: Enraged Wildkin
objectivesText: Locate Jaron Stoneshaper's wrecked camp and supplies in southern Winterspring.

4862.name: En-Ay-Es-Tee-Why
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 15 Spire Spider Eggs for Kibler.
By the sound of it, these eggs could be found near spiders.

4863.name: Enraged Wildkin
objectivesText: Find Jaron Stoneshaper's wrecked wagon.

4864.name: Enraged Wildkin
objectivesText: Pick up Jaron's Supplies from the snow, then find the wildkin that stole the amulet Jaron spoke of.
Bring Jaron's Supplies and the Blue-feathered Amulet to Jaron Stoneshaper at the lodge in Winterspring.

4865.name: Serpent Wild
objectivesText: Report your findings to Motega Firemane.

4866.name: Mother's Milk
objectivesText: In the heart of Blackrock Spire you will find Mother Smolderweb. Engage her and get her to poison you. Chances are good that you will have to kill her as well. Return to Ragged John when you are poisoned so that he can 'milk' you.

4867.name: Urok Doomhowl
objectivesText: Read Warosh's Scroll. Bring Warosh's Mojo to Warosh.

4881.name: Assassination Plot
objectivesText: Warn Kanati Greycloud at Whitereach Post of the plot to kill him.

4882.name: Guarding Secrets
objectivesText: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Trull Failbane at Bloodvenom Post.

4883.name: Guarding Secrets
objectivesText: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Nara Wildmane.

4901.name: Guardians of the Altar
objectivesText: Protect Ranshalla while she attempts to reactivate the Altar of Elune. Report your findings to Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.

4902.name: Wildkin of Elune
objectivesText: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

4903.name: Warlord's Command
objectivesText: Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.

4904.name: Free at Last
objectivesText: Escort Lakota Windsong from the Darkcloud Pinnacle, and then talk to Thalia Amberhide at Freewind Post.

4906.name: Further Corruption
objectivesText: Eridan Bluewind in Felwood wants you to kill 8 Jadefire Hellcallers, 8 Jadefire Betrayers, 8 Jadefire Tricksters, and Xavaric. Return to Eridan when the task is completed.

4907.name: Tinkee Steamboil
objectivesText: Speak with Tinkee Steamboil.

4921.name: Lost in Battle
objectivesText: Find Mankrik's wife and then return to him in the Crossroads.

4941.name: Eitrigg's Wisdom
objectivesText: Speak with Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. When you have discussed matters with Eitrigg, seek council from Thrall.
You recall having seen Eitrigg in Thrall's chamber.

4961.name: Cleansing of the Orb of Orahil
objectivesText: Kill the Demon of the Orb, then speak with Tabetha.

4962.name: Shard of a Felhound
objectivesText: Take the Felhas Ruby and use it on one of the Felhounds found in Desolace. After successful, bring the Felhas Ruby and the Imprisoned Felhound Spirit back to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4963.name: Shard of an Infernal
objectivesText: Take the Infus Emerald and use it on one of the Infernals found in Desolace. After successful, bring the Infus Emerald and the Imprisoned Infernal Spirit back to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4964.name: The Completed Orb of Dar'Orahil
objectivesText: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Dar'Orahil and then speak to her again.

4965.name: Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil
objectivesText: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4966.name: Protect Kanati Greycloud
objectivesText: Protect Kanati Greycloud from the centaur attack.

4967.name: Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil
objectivesText: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4968.name: Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil
objectivesText: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4969.name: Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil
objectivesText: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4970.name: Frostsaber Provisions
objectivesText: Collect 5 Shardtooth Meats and 5 Chillwind Meats for Rivern Frostwind in Winterspring.

4971.name: A Matter of Time
objectivesText: Use the Temporal Displacer near one of Andorhal's silos and uncover Temporal Parasites.
Slay 10 Temporal Parasites, and then return the Temporal Displacer to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

4972.name: Counting Out Time
objectivesText: Locate 5 Andorhal Watches, found in lockboxes amongst the rubble of the city. Return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

4973.name: Counting Out Time
objectivesText: Locate 5 Andorhal Watches amongst the rubble of the city, and return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

4974.name: For The Horde!
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Warchief Rend Blackhand. Take his head and return to Orgrimmar.

4975.name: The Completed Orb of Noh'Orahil
objectivesText: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Noh'Orahil and then speak to her again.

4976.name: Returning the Cleansed Orb
objectivesText: Return the Cleansed Infernal Orb to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4981.name: Operative Bijou
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find out what happened to Bijou.

4982.name: Bijou's Belongings
objectivesText: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. You recall her mentioning that she stashed them on the bottom floor of the city.

4983.name: Bijou's Reconnaissance Report
objectivesText: Take Bijou's Reconnaissance Report back to Grandmaster Lexlort in Kargath.

4984.name: The Wildlife Suffers Too
objectivesText: Destroy 8 Diseased Wolves, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.

4985.name: The Wildlife Suffers Too
objectivesText: Destroy 8 Diseased Grizzlies, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.

4986.name: Glyphed Oaken Branch
objectivesText: Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Darnassus is the next step the tauren druid sought. Seek one of the druids there for assistance.

4987.name: Glyphed Oaken Branch
objectivesText: Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is the next step the tauren druid sought. Seek one of the druids there for assistance.

5001.name: Bijou's Belongings
objectivesText: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. Good luck!

5002.name: Message to Maxwell
objectivesText: Travel to the Burning Steppes and give Bijou's Information to Marshal Maxwell.

5021.name: Better Late Than Never
objectivesText: The ramblings of the ghostly woman indicated that she needed a package delivered. She claimed that it was where her horse was. As to where the horse is or where the package was to be delivered - the ghost remains incomprehensible.

5022.name: Better Late Than Never
objectivesText: Check with the Royal Factors of Stormwind to learn the whereabouts of an Emma Felstone. There is usually a census officer located in City Hall.

5023.name: Better Late Than Never
objectivesText: Check with the Royal Overseers of the Undercity to learn the whereabouts of a Jeremiah Felstone. There is usually a census officer located near guild and tabard registration.

5041.name: Supplies for the Crossroads
objectivesText: Find and return Crossroads' Supply Crates to Thork in the Barrens.

5047.name: Pip Quickwit, At Your Service!
objectivesText: Talk to Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook.

5048.name: Good Natured Emma
objectivesText: Find Ol' Emma in Stormwind and see if she is in fact Emma Felstone. If she is, then perhaps she'd like the package Janice Felstone made for her.

5049.name: The Jeremiah Blues
objectivesText: Find Jeremiah Payson in the Undercity and see if he is in fact Jeremiah Felstone. If he is, then perhaps he'd like the package Janice Felstone made for him.

5050.name: Good Luck Charm
objectivesText: Return to Janice Felstone in Western Plaguelands her Good Luck Half-Charm.

5051.name: Two Halves Become One
objectivesText: Locate the other half of the Good Luck Charm somewhere on the Felstone Farm in Western Plaguelands and reassemble it.
Give the Good Luck Charm to Janice Felstone on the Felstone Farm, Western Plaguelands.

5052.name: Blood Shards of Agamaggan
objectivesText: Bring a Blood Shard to Mangletooth in Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
Collect more Blood Shards if you want him to bless you with Agamaggan's power.

5054.name: Ursius of the Shardtooth
objectivesText: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Ursius.

5055.name: Brumeran of the Chillwind
objectivesText: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Brumeran.

5056.name: Shy-Rotam
objectivesText: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to defeat Shy-Rotam.

5061.name: Aquatic Form
objectivesText: Return to Darnassus and show Mathrengyl Bearwalker the Pendant of the Sea Lion.

5062.name: Sacred Fire
objectivesText: Gather 10 bushels of Incendia Agave, and then consult Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise in Thunderbluff.

5063.name: Cap of the Scarlet Savant
