objectivesText: In order to create the Cap of the Scarlet Savant, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 8 Arcane Crystals; 5 Enchanted Scarlet Thread.
You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

5064.name: Grimtotem Spying
objectivesText: Locate and retrieve the three Secret Notes in Darkcloud Pinnacle.

5065.name: The Lost Tablets of Mosh'aru
objectivesText: Bring the Third and Fourth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

5066.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
objectivesText: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist. His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.

5067.name: Leggings of Arcana
objectivesText: In order to create the Leggings of Arcana, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Frostwhisper's Embalming Fluid.
You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

5068.name: Breastplate of Bloodthirst
objectivesText: In order to create the Breastplate of Bloodthirst, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Skin of Shadow.
You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

5081.name: Maxwell's Mission
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy War Master Voone, Highlord Omokk, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.

5082.name: Threat of the Winterfall
objectivesText: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Pathfinders, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Totemics.

5083.name: Winterfall Firewater
objectivesText: Bring the Empty Firewater Flask to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

5084.name: Falling to Corruption
objectivesText: Search the Deadwood furbolg camp in northern Felwood for a clue.

5085.name: Mystery Goo
objectivesText: Report back to Donova Snowden with your findings.

5086.name: Toxic Horrors
objectivesText: Collect 3 Toxic Horror Droplets for Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

5087.name: Winterfall Runners
objectivesText: Find the Winterfall Runners and stop them from delivering their shipment to Winterfall Village.

5088.name: Arikara
objectivesText: Slay Arikara. Bring her remains and the Incendia powder to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post as proof of your deed.

5089.name: General Drakkisath's Command
objectivesText: Take General Drakkisath's Command to Marshal Maxwell in Burning Steppes.

5090.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
objectivesText: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist. His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.

5091.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
objectivesText: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist. His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.

5092.name: Clear the Way
objectivesText: Kill 10 Skeletal Flayers and 10 Slavering Ghouls in Sorrow Hill.
Return to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5093.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
objectivesText: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.

5094.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
objectivesText: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.

5095.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
objectivesText: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glades and the Undercity.

5096.name: Scarlet Diversions
objectivesText: Proceed to the Scarlet Crusade's base camp between Felstone Field and Dalson's Tears and destroy their command tent.
Place the Scourge banner at the camp, and then return to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5097.name: All Along the Watchtowers
objectivesText: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.
Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to Commander Ashlam Valorfist in Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5098.name: All Along the Watchtowers
objectivesText: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.
Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5102.name: General Drakkisath's Demise
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy General Drakkisath. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.

5103.name: Hot Fiery Death
objectivesText: Someone in this world must know what to do with these gauntlets. Good luck!

5121.name: High Chief Winterfall
objectivesText: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to defeat High Chief Winterfall.

5123.name: The Final Piece
objectivesText: Bring the Crudely-written Log to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

5124.name: Fiery Plate Gauntlets
objectivesText: Bring Malyfous Darkhammer 6 Enchanted Thorium Bars, 2 Essence of Fire, and 4 Star Rubies. You will also need to turn in your Unfired Plate Gauntlets.

5126.name: Lorax's Tale
objectivesText: Speak with Lorax. Listen to what he has to say.

5127.name: The Demon Forge
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Goraluk Anvilcrack. Slay him and then use the Blood Stained Pike upon his corpse. After his soul has been siphoned, the pike will be Soul Stained.
You must also find the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate.
Return both the Soul Stained Pike and the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate to Lorax in Winterspring.

5128.name: Words of the High Chief
objectivesText: Take the Crudely-written Log to Kelek Skykeeper in southern Felwood.

5141.name: Dragonscale Leatherworking
objectivesText: Bring 2 Tough Scorpid Breastplates, 2 Tough Scorpid Gloves, and 10 Worn Dragonscales to Peter Galen in Azshara.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Dragonscale Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Elemental Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5142.name: Little Pamela
objectivesText: Find Pamela Redpath.

5143.name: Tribal Leatherworking
objectivesText: Bring a Wild Leather Vest and a Wild Leather Helmet to Caryssia Moonhunter in Feralas.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Tribal Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Elemental Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5144.name: Elemental Leatherworking
objectivesText: Bring 2 Heart of Fire, 2 Globe of Water, 2 Core of Earth, and 2 Breath of Wind to Sarah Tanner in Searing Gorge.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Elemental Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5145.name: Dragonscale Leatherworking
objectivesText: Bring 2 Tough Scorpid Breastplates, 2 Tough Scorpid Gloves, and 10 Worn Dragonscales to Thorkaf Dragoneye in the Badlands.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Dragonscale Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Elemental Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5146.name: Elemental Leatherworking
objectivesText: Bring 2 Heart of Fire, 2 Globe of Water, 2 Core of Earth, and 2 Breath of Wind to Brumn Winterhoof in the Arathi Mountains.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Elemental Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5147.name: Wanted - Arnak Grimtotem
objectivesText: Slay Arnak Grimtotem and bring proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.

5148.name: Tribal Leatherworking
objectivesText: Bring a Wild Leather Vest and a Wild Leather Helmet to Se'Jib in Stranglethorn Vale.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Tribal Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Elemental Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5149.name: Pamela's Doll
objectivesText: Find Pamela's doll.

5151.name: Hypercapacitor Gizmo
objectivesText: Slay the beast and bring back the Hypercapacitor Gizmo and Panther Cage Key to Wizlo Bearingshiner.

5152.name: Auntie Marlene
objectivesText: Speak with Marlene, south of the Ruins of Andorhal.

5153.name: A Strange Historian
objectivesText: Bring Joseph's Wedding Ring to Chromie.

5154.name: The Annals of Darrowshire
objectivesText: Bring the Annals of Darrowshire to Chromie in Andorhal.

5155.name: Forces of Jaedenar
objectivesText: Enter Jaedenar and slay 4 Jaedenar Hounds, 4 Jaedenar Guardsmen, 6 Jaedenar Adepts, and 6 Jaedenar Cultists before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5156.name: Verifying the Corruption
objectivesText: Seek out and destroy 2 Entropic Beasts and 2 Entropic Horrors while exploring Shatter Scar Vale. After checking to see if the craters there are still filled with corrupt fel water, return to Taronn Redfeather in Felwood.

5157.name: Collection of the Corrupt Water
objectivesText: Take the Empty Canteen to the Moon Well in the center of Jaedenar and fill it before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5158.name: Seeking Spiritual Aid
objectivesText: Take the Corrupt Moon Well Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.

5159.name: Cleansed Water Returns to Felwood
objectivesText: Take the Purified Moon Well Water to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5160.name: The Matron Protectorate
objectivesText: Travel to Winterspring and find Haleh. Give her Awbee's scale.

5161.name: Wrath of the Blue Flight
objectivesText: Speak with Haleh if you wish to continue.

5162.name: Wrath of the Blue Flight
objectivesText: Speak with Jeziba in the Plaguelands. He resides in Andorhal.

5163.name: Are We There, Yeti?
objectivesText: Take Umi's Mechanical Yeti and scare her friends with it:
Legacki in Everlook (Winterspring)
Sprinkle in Gadgetzan (Tanaris)
Quixxil in Marshal's Refuge (Un'Goro Crater)
When you are done, bring the Mechanical Yeti back to Umi.

5164.name: Catalogue of the Wayward
objectivesText: Read from the Catalogue of the Wayward.

5165.name: Dousing the Flames of Protection
objectivesText: Using the Purified Moon Well Water, douse the flames of the four braziers of protection within Shadow Hold in Felwood, then return to Greta Mosshoof in the Emerald Sanctuary.

5166.name: Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight
objectivesText: To forge the Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor':
1 Chromatic Carapace.
10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales.
10 Blood of Heroes.
10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings.

5167.name: Legplates of the Chromatic Defier
objectivesText: To forge the Legplates of the Chromatic Defier, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor':
1 Chromatic Carapace.
10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales.
10 Blood of Heroes.
5 Skin of Shadow.

5168.name: Heroes of Darrowshire
objectivesText: Bring Davil's Libram and Redpath's Shield to Carlin Redpath.

5181.name: Villains of Darrowshire
objectivesText: Bring the Skull of Horgus and the Shattered Sword of Marduk to Carlin Redpath at Light's Hope Chapel.

5201.name: Winterfall Intrusion
objectivesText: Rivern Frostwind wants you to slay 5 Winterfall Shaman and 5 Winterfall Ursa.

5202.name: A Strange Red Key
objectivesText: Search through Jaedenar to discover what the Blood Red Key is used for.

5203.name: Rescue From Jaedenar
objectivesText: Escort Arko'narin to where Lightforge and her equipment are being held, and then protect her as you escape Shadow Hold. Afterwards, seek out Jessir Moonbow in Felwood to let her know what's happened to her friends.

5204.name: Retribution of the Light
objectivesText: Return to Jaedenar and kill the succubus Rakaiah before finding the Remains of Trey Lightforge.

5206.name: Marauders of Darrowshire
objectivesText: Bring 5 Resonating Skulls and the Mystic Crystal to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

5210.name: Brother Carlin
objectivesText: Bring the Extended Annals of Darrowshire to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

5211.name: Defenders of Darrowshire
objectivesText: Free 15 Darrowshire Spirits and return to Carlin Redpath.

5212.name: The Flesh Does Not Lie
objectivesText: Recover 10 Plagued Flesh Samples from Stratholme and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in Stratholme would have said flesh sample.

5213.name: The Active Agent
objectivesText: Travel to Stratholme and search the ziggurats. Find and return new Scourge Data to Betina Bigglezink.

5214.name: The Great Ezra Grimm
objectivesText: Find Ezra Grimm's smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Grimm's Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.

5215.name: The Scourge Cauldrons
objectivesText: Speak with High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

5216.name: Target: Felstone Field
objectivesText: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there. It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5217.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
objectivesText: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5219.name: Target: Dalson's Tears
objectivesText: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5220.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
objectivesText: Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5222.name: Target: Writhing Haunt
objectivesText: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5223.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
objectivesText: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5225.name: Target: Gahrron's Withering
objectivesText: Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Gahrron's Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5226.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
objectivesText: Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5228.name: The Scourge Cauldrons
objectivesText: Speak with Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5229.name: Target: Felstone Field
objectivesText: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there. It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5230.name: Return to the Bulwark
objectivesText: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5231.name: Target: Dalson's Tears
objectivesText: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5232.name: Return to the Bulwark
objectivesText: Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5233.name: Target: Writhing Haunt
objectivesText: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5234.name: Return to the Bulwark
objectivesText: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at The Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5235.name: Target: Gahrron's Withering
objectivesText: Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Gahrron's Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5236.name: Return to the Bulwark
objectivesText: Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5241.name: Uncle Carlin
objectivesText: Find Carlin Redpath.

5242.name: A Final Blow
objectivesText: Kill Moora and Salia, and bring Shadow Lord Fel'dan's Head to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5243.name: Houses of the Holy
objectivesText: Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.

5244.name: The Ruins of Kel'Theril
objectivesText: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper in Starfall Village.

5245.name: Troubled Spirits of Kel'Theril
objectivesText: Use Jaron's Pick to find the four Highborne Relic Fragments. Bring them to Aurora Skycaller in Eastern Plaguelands.

5246.name: Fragments of the Past
objectivesText: Find the Sacred Highborne Writings in the Temple of Zin-Malor in Azshara, and bring them to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

5247.name: Fragments of the Past
objectivesText: Bring an Enchanted Thorium Bar, 5 Crystal Restore, and a Vial of Dire Water to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

5248.name: Tormented By the Past
objectivesText: Take the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Lake Kel'Theril in Winterspring and find a highborne spirit that will speak to you.

5249.name: To Winterspring!
objectivesText: Find Starfall Village in Winterspring and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.

5250.name: Starfall
objectivesText: Find Starfall in Winterspring and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.

5251.name: The Archivist
objectivesText: Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.

5252.name: Remorseful Highborne
objectivesText: Speak with Wynd Nightchaser in Starfall Village, and ask about the proper place for the Crystal of Zin-Malor.

5253.name: The Crystal of Zin-Malor
objectivesText: Deliver the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

5261.name: Eagan Peltskinner
objectivesText: Speak with Eagan Peltskinner.

5262.name: The Truth Comes Crashing Down
objectivesText: Take the Head of Balnazzar to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff in the Eastern Plaguelands.

5263.name: Above and Beyond
objectivesText: Venture to Stratholme and destroy Baron Rivendare. Take his head and return to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff.

5264.name: Lord Maxwell Tyrosus
objectivesText: Speak with Lord Maxwell Tyrosus. He is inside the church.

5265.name: The Argent Hold
objectivesText: Open the Argent Hold and claim your reward.

5281.name: The Restless Souls
objectivesText: Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around Stratholme.

5282.name: The Restless Souls
objectivesText: Use Egan's Blaster on the ghostly and spectral citizens of Stratholme. When the restless souls break free from their ghostly shells, use the blaster again - freedom will be theirs!
Free 15 Restless Souls and return to Egan.

5283.name: The Art of the Armorsmith
objectivesText: To become an Armorsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Grumnus: 4 Ornate Mithril Helms, 2 Ornate Mithril Boots, 1 Ornate Mithril Breastplate.

5284.name: The Way of the Weaponsmith
objectivesText: To become a Weaponsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Ironus: 4 Moonsteel Broadswords, 4 Massive Iron Axes, 2 Heavy Mithril Axes, and 2 Big Black Maces.

5301.name: The Art of the Armorsmith
objectivesText: To become an armorsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Okothos: 4 Ornate Mithril Helms, 2 Ornate Mithril Boots, 1 Ornate Mithril Breastplate.

5302.name: The Way of the Weaponsmith
objectivesText: To become a Weaponsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Borgosh: 4 Moonsteel Broadswords, 4 Massive Iron Axes, 2 Heavy Mithril Axes, and 2 Big Black Maces.

5305.name: Sweet Serenity
objectivesText: Travel to Stratholme and kill the Crimson Hammersmith. Recover the Crimson Hammersmith's Apron and return to Lilith.

5306.name: Snakestone of the Shadow Huntress
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin. Recover Vosh'gajin's Snakestone and return to Kilram.

5307.name: Corruption
objectivesText: Find the Black Guard Swordsmith in Stratholme and destroy him. Recover the Insignia of the Black Guard and return to Seril Scourgebane.

5321.name: The Sleeper Has Awakened
objectivesText: Escort Kerlonian Evershade to Liladris Moonriver at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.

5341.name: Barov Family Fortune
objectivesText: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have completed this task.

5342.name: The Last Barov
objectivesText: Travel to Chillwind Camp - Alliance territory - and assassinate Weldon Barov. Take his head and return to Alexi Barov.
Be warned, Weldon will probably be well protected by Alliance scum.

5343.name: Barov Family Fortune
objectivesText: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Weldon Barov when you have completed this task.

5344.name: The Last Barov
objectivesText: Travel to the Bulwark - Horde territory - and assassinate Alexi Barov. Take his head and return to Weldon Barov.
Be warned, Alexi will probably be well protected by Horde filth.

5361.name: Family Tree
objectivesText: Deliver Cliffwatcher Longhorn Report to Nataka Longhorn at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.

5381.name: Hand of Iruxos
objectivesText: Retrieve the Demon Box from Thunder Axe Fortress, and return it, along with the Demon Pick to Taiga Wisemane in Shadowprey Village.

5382.name: Doctor Theolen Krastinov, the Butcher
objectivesText: Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.

5384.name: Kirtonos the Herald
objectivesText: Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul.
Fight valiantly, do not give an inch! Destroy Kirtonos and return to Eva Sarkhoff.

5385.name: The Remains of Trey Lightforge
objectivesText: Return the Remains of Trey Lightforge to Jessir Moonbow in Felwood.

5386.name: Catch of the Day
objectivesText: Talk to Jinar'Zillen at Shadowprey Village, and then bring Nataka Longhorn 2 Bloodbelly fish.

5441.name: Lazy Peons
objectivesText: Use the Foreman's Blackjack on Lazy Peons when they're sleeping. Wake up 5 peons, then return the Foreman's Blackjack to Foreman Thazz'ril in the Valley of Trials.

5461.name: The Human, Ras Frostwhisper
objectivesText: Travel to the Arathi Highlands, to the ruins of Stromgarde. Search Stromgarde for a Keepsake of Remembrance. If you find such an item, return with it to Magistrate Marduke.

5462.name: The Dying, Ras Frostwhisper
objectivesText: Travel to Light's Hope in Eastern Plaguelands and seek out Leonid Barthalomew the Revered. Show him the Keepsake of Remembrance and tell him all that you have discovered.

5463.name: Menethil's Gift
objectivesText: Travel to Stratholme and find Menethil's Gift. Place the Keepsake of Remembrance upon the unholy ground.

5464.name: Menethil's Gift
objectivesText: Take the Soulbound Keepsake to Leonid Barthalomew in Eastern Plaguelands.

5465.name: Soulbound Keepsake
objectivesText: Return to Magistrate Marduke in Caer Darrow. Show him the Soulbound Keepsake.

5466.name: The Lich, Ras Frostwhisper
objectivesText: Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrate Marduke.

5481.name: Gordo's Task
objectivesText: Collect 3 Gloom Weed and deliver them to Junior Apothecary Holland in the Brill graveyard.

5482.name: Doom Weed
objectivesText: Collect 10 Doom Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.

5501.name: Bone Collector
objectivesText: Bring 10 Kodo Bones from the Kodo Graveyard to Bibbly F'utzbuckle at Kormek's Hut.

5502.name: A Warden of the Horde
objectivesText: Return your ward to the Orgrimmar orphanage by handing in the Orcish Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Battlewail in the Valley of Honor.

5504.name: Mantles of the Dawn
objectivesText: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Hasana at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5507.name: Mantles of the Dawn
objectivesText: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Lightspark at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5513.name: Mantles of the Dawn
objectivesText: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.

5514.name: Mold Rhymes With...
objectivesText: Bring the Imbued Skeletal Fragments and 15 gold coins to Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan.

5515.name: Krastinov's Bag of Horrors
objectivesText: Locate Jandice Barov in the Scholomance and destroy her. From her corpse recover Krastinov's Bag of Horrors. Return the bag to Eva Sarkhoff.

5517.name: Chromatic Mantle of the Dawn
objectivesText: Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.

5518.name: The Gordok Ogre Suit
objectivesText: Bring 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Threads, and Ogre Tannin to Knot Thimblejack. He is currently chained inside the Gordok wing of Dire Maul.

5521.name: Chromatic Mantle of the Dawn
objectivesText: Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Lightspark at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5522.name: Leonid Barthalomew
objectivesText: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Leonid Barthalomew in the Eastern Plaguelands.

objectivesText: Travel to the Undercity and speak with Varimathras.

6145.name: The Crimson Courier
objectivesText: Return to Eastern Plaguelands and track down the Crimson Courier. Kill the Courier and recover the Grand Crusader's Command.
Take the command to Nathanos Blightcaller for further instruction.

6146.name: Nathanos' Ruse
objectivesText: Travel to Tyr's Hand, southeast of the Marris Stead. Once there, take a bite of the Rotten Apple. While under the guise of the Scarlet Crusade, deliver the Grand Crusader's Command to Crusader Lord Valdelmar.

6147.name: Return to Nathanos
objectivesText: Return to Nathanos Blightcaller with the new information.

6148.name: The Scarlet Oracle, Demetria
objectivesText: The Scarlet Crusade is on the move. Somewhere along the road from Tyr's Hand to Stratholme you will find the Oracle, Demetria, and her entourage. Hunt her down and slay her. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller should you succeed.

6161.name: Claim Rackmore's Treasure!
objectivesText: Find Rackmore's Silver Key. Find Rackmore's Golden Key. Find and open Rackmore's Chest.

6162.name: A Husband's Last Battle
objectivesText: Kill Overlord Ror and return his claw to Dreka'Sur at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.

6163.name: Ramstein
objectivesText: Travel to Stratholme and slay Ramstein the Gorger. Take his head as a souvenir for Nathanos.

6164.name: Augustus' Receipt Book
objectivesText: Bring Augustus' Receipt Book to Augustus the Touched in Terrordale.

6181.name: A Swift Message
objectivesText: Bring Lewis' Note to Thor the gryphon master.

6182.name: The First and the Last
objectivesText: Speak with Mathias Shaw in Old Town Stormwind. He resides in the Barracks.

6183.name: Honor the Dead
objectivesText: Speak with Mathias Shaw again if you wish to accept his task.

6184.name: Flint Shadowmore
objectivesText: Travel to Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands and meet up with your contact, Flint Shadowmore.

6185.name: The Eastern Plagues
objectivesText: Scour the Eastern Plaguelands for clues as to the "Blightcaller" and the missing SI:7 agents. If you find any SI:7 Insignias, return them to Flint Shadowmore at Chillwind Camp.

6186.name: The Blightcaller Cometh
objectivesText: Return to Stormwind and inform Highlord Bolvar Fordragon of the fate of Nathanos Marris.

6187.name: Order Must Be Restored
objectivesText: Assemble an army and travel to the Eastern Plaguelands. Launch a full assault on Nathanos Blightcaller and any Horde filth that may attempt to protect him.
Keep your wits about you, <Name>. The Horde will defend the ranger lord with their very lives.

6261.name: Dungar Longdrink
objectivesText: Bring Osric's Crate to Dungar Longdrink the gryphon master.

6281.name: Continue to Stormwind
objectivesText: Buy a gryphon ride from the gryphon master Thor, then bring Lewis' Note to Osric Strang, in the shop Limited Immunity, in the Old Town of Stormwind.

6282.name: Harpies Threaten
objectivesText: Maggran Earthbinder in Sun Rock Retreat wants you to slay 7 Bloodfury Harpies, 7 Bloodfury Ambushers, 7 Bloodfury Slayers and 7 Bloodfury Roguefeathers.

6283.name: Bloodfury Bloodline
objectivesText: Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat wishes you to slay Bloodfury Ripper and bring her remains as proof of your deed.

6284.name: Arachnophobia
objectivesText: Kill Besseleth and bring Besseleth's Fang to Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat.

6285.name: Return to Lewis
objectivesText: Buy a gryphon ride to Sentinel Hill from the gryphon master Dungar Longdrink, then take Osric's Crate to Lewis at Sentinel Hill.

6301.name: Cycle of Rebirth
objectivesText: Tammra Windfield at Sun Rock Retreat wants you to gather 10 Gaea Seeds.

6321.name: Supplying the Sepulcher
objectivesText: Bring Podrig's Order to Karos Razok.

6322.name: Michael Garrett
objectivesText: Bring Gordon's Crate to Michael Garrett.

6323.name: Ride to the Undercity
objectivesText: Buy a bat ride to the Undercity from the bat master Karos Razok, then take Podrig's Order to Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.

6324.name: Return to Podrig
objectivesText: Buy a bat ride to the Sepulcher from the bat master Michael Garrett, then bring Gordon's Crate to Deathguard Podrig in the Sepulcher.

6341.name: The Bounty of Teldrassil
objectivesText: Bring Nessa's Collection to Vesprystus.

6342.name: Flight to Auberdine
objectivesText: Ride a hippogryph to Auberdine from the hippogryph master Vesprystus, then bring Nessa's Collection to Laird.

6343.name: Return to Nessa
objectivesText: Bring Laird's Response to Nessa Shadowsong.

6344.name: Nessa Shadowsong
objectivesText: Speak with Nessa Shadowsong.

6361.name: A Bundle of Hides
objectivesText: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the wind rider master Devrak in the Crossroads.

6362.name: Ride to Thunder Bluff
objectivesText: Buy a wind rider to Thunder Bluff from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring the Bundle of Hides to Ahanu in Thunder Bluff.

6363.name: Tal the Wind Rider Master
objectivesText: Bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Tal in Thunder Bluff.

6364.name: Return to Jahan
objectivesText: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Tal, then bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Jahan Hawkwing.

6365.name: Meats to Orgrimmar
objectivesText: Bring Zargh's Meats to Devrak in the Crossroads.

6381.name: New Life
objectivesText: Plant 10 Gaea Seeds in Gaea Dirt Mounds, and then return the remaining Enchanted Gaea Seeds to Tammra at Sun Rock Retreat.

6382.name: The Ashenvale Hunt
objectivesText: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.

6384.name: Ride to Orgrimmar
objectivesText: Buy a wind rider to Orgrimmar from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring Zargh's Meats to Gryshka in Orgrimmar.

6385.name: Doras the Wind Rider Master
objectivesText: Bring Gryshka's Letter to Doras in Orgrimmar.

6386.name: Return to the Crossroads.
objectivesText: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Doras, then bring Gryshka's Letter to Zargh at the Crossroads.

6387.name: Honor Students
objectivesText: Bring Brock's List to Thorgrum Borrelson in Thelsamar.

6388.name: Gryth Thurden
objectivesText: Bring the Honorary Picks to Gryth Thurden in Ironforge.

6389.name: A Plague Upon Thee
objectivesText: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

6390.name: A Plague Upon Thee
objectivesText: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

6391.name: Ride to Ironforge
objectivesText: Buy a gryphon to Ironforge from the gryphon master Thorgrum Borrelson, then bring Brock's List to Golnir Bouldertoe in Ironforge.

6392.name: Return to Brock
objectivesText: Buy a gryphon to Thelsamar from the gryphon master Gryth Thurden, then bring the Honorary Picks to Brock Stoneseeker in Thelsamar.

6393.name: Elemental War
objectivesText: Bring 10 Incendrites to Tsunaman at Sun Rock Retreat.

6394.name: Thazz'ril's Pick
objectivesText: Bring Thazz'ril's Pick to Foreman Thazz'ril.

6395.name: Marla's Last Wish
objectivesText: Bring Samuel Fipps' Remains to Marla's Grave, then return to Novice Elreth.

6401.name: Kaya's Alive
objectivesText: Tell Tammra Windfield in Sun Rock Retreat the good news.

6402.name: Stormwind Rendezvous
objectivesText: Travel to Stormwind City and venture to the city gates. Speak with Squire Rowe so that he may let Marshal Windsor know that you have arrived.

6403.name: The Great Masquerade
objectivesText: Follow Reginald Windsor through Stormwind. Protect him from harm!

6421.name: Boulderslide Ravine
objectivesText: Explore deep into the cave at Boulderslide Ravine and bring back 10 Resonite Crystals for Mor'rogal at Sun Rock Retreat to investigate.

6441.name: Satyr Horns
objectivesText: Collect 16 Satyr Horns for Pixel in Splintertree Post.

6442.name: Naga at the Zoram Strand
objectivesText: Bring 20 Wrathtail Heads to Marukai along the Zoram Strand.

6461.name: Blood Feeders
objectivesText: Xen'zilla at Malaka'Jin needs you to kill 10 Deepmoss Creepers and 7 Deepmoss Venomspitters.

6462.name: Troll Charm
objectivesText: Bring 8 Troll Charms to Mitsuwa at the Zoram'gar Outpost.

6481.name: Earthen Arise
objectivesText: Open the Resonite cask with the Enchanted Resonite Crystal, and then slay Goggeroc. Return to Mor'rogal with the news and Enchanted Resonite Crystal.

6482.name: Freedom to Ruul
objectivesText: Escort Ruul, then speak with Yama Snowhoof in Splintertree Post.

6501.name: The Dragon's Eye
objectivesText: You must search the world for a being capable of restoring the power to the Fragment of the Dragon's Eye. The only information you possess about such a being is that they exist.

6502.name: Drakefire Amulet
objectivesText: You must retrieve the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath. Drakkisath can be found in his throne room behind the Halls of Ascension in Blackrock Spire.

6503.name: Ashenvale Outrunners
objectivesText: Kill 9 Ashenvale Outrunners, then return to Kuray'bin at Splintertree Outpost.

6504.name: The Lost Pages
objectivesText: Find the 12 missing pages of the Shredder Operating Manual, and put them together to form Chapters 1, 2, and 3. Return the pages to Gurda Ragescar near Splintertree Post.

6521.name: An Unholy Alliance
objectivesText: Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Varimathras in the Undercity.

6522.name: An Unholy Alliance
objectivesText: Take the Small Scroll to Varimathras in the Undercity.

6523.name: Protect Kaya
objectivesText: Escort Kaya Flathoof to Camp Aparaje, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

6541.name: Report to Kadrak
objectivesText: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern Barrens.

6542.name: Report to Kadrak
objectivesText: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern Barrens.

6543.name: The Warsong Reports
objectivesText: Open the Bundle of Reports. Take the Warsong Reports to the Warsong Scout, Warsong Runner, and Warsong Outrider. Bring back the updates they give you to Kadrak at the northern watch tower in the barrens.

6544.name: Torek's Assault
objectivesText: Escort Torek on his attack against Silverwing Outpost and Duriel Moonfire, then report to Ertog Ragetusk at Splintertree Post.

6548.name: Avenge My Village
objectivesText: Kill 8 Grimtotem Ruffians and 6 Grimtotem Mercenaries, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

6561.name: Blackfathom Villainy
objectivesText: Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

6562.name: Trouble in the Deeps
objectivesText: Speak to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

6563.name: The Essence of Aku'Mai
objectivesText: Bring 20 Sapphires of Aku'Mai to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

6564.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
objectivesText: Bring the Damp Note to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

6565.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
objectivesText: Kill Lorgus Jett in Blackfathom Deeps and then return to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

6566.name: What the Wind Carries
objectivesText: Listen to Thrall.

6567.name: The Champion of the Horde
objectivesText: Seek out Rexxar. The Warchief has instructed you as to his whereabouts. Search the paths of Desolace, between the Stonetalon Mountains and Feralas.

6568.name: The Testament of Rexxar
objectivesText: Deliver Rexxar's Letter to Myranda the Hag in the Western Plaguelands.

6569.name: Oculus Illusions
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 20 Black Dragonspawn Eyes. Return to Myranda the Hag when the task is complete.

6570.name: Emberstrife
objectivesText: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh and seek out Emberstrife's Den. Once inside, wear the Amulet of Draconic Subversion and speak with Emberstrife.

6571.name: Warsong Supplies
objectivesText: Collect the Warsong Supplies: Warsong Saw Blades, Logging Rope, Warsong Oil, and the Warsong Axe Shipment for Locke Okarr in Splintertree Post.

6582.name: The Test of Skulls, Scryer
objectivesText: You must find the blue dragonflight drake champion, Scryer, and slay him. Pry his skull from his corpse and return it to Emberstrife.
You know that Scryer can be found in Winterspring.

6583.name: The Test of Skulls, Somnus
objectivesText: Destroy the drake champion of the Green Flight, Somnus. Take his skull and return it to Emberstrife.

6584.name: The Test of Skulls, Chronalis
objectivesText: Guarding the Caverns of Time in the Tanaris Desert is Chronalis, child of Nozdormu. Destroy him and return his skull to Emberstrife.

6585.name: The Test of Skulls, Axtroz
objectivesText: Travel to Grim Batol and track down Axtroz, drake champion of the Red Flight. Destroy him and take his skull. Return the skull to Emberstrife.

6601.name: Ascension...
objectivesText: It would appear as if the charade is over. You know that the Amulet of Draconic Subversion that Myranda the Hag created for you will not function inside Blackrock Spire. Perhaps you should find Rexxar and explain your predicament. Show him the Dull Drakefire Amulet. Hopefully he will know what to do next.

6602.name: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay General Drakkisath. Gather his blood and return it to Rexxar.

6603.name: Trouble in Winterspring!
objectivesText: Find Donova Snowden near the hot springs in Winterspring.

6604.name: Enraged Wildkin
objectivesText: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper at Starfall Village.

6605.name: A Strange One
objectivesText: Speak with Winna Hazzard in Felwood.

6606.name: A Little Luck
objectivesText: Speak with Witch Doctor Mau'ari in Everlook.

6607.name: Nat Pagle, Angler Extreme
objectivesText: Nat Pagle wants you to catch the following fish:
Misty Reed Mahi Mahi from the Misty Reed Strand in the Swamp of Sorrows.
A Sar'theris Striker from the Sar'theris Strand in Desolace.
Feralas Ahi from the Verdantis River of Feralas.
Savage Coast Blue Sailfin from the Savage Coast of Stranglethorn Vale.
Return to Nat Pagle when you have reeled them all in!

6608.name: You Too Good.
objectivesText: You think Lumak is trying to tell you that he can no longer help you improve your fishing skill. You may want to try to find his friend, Nat Pagle, a human fishing off one of the islands south of Theramore (at least that's what you think Lumak said).

6609.name: I Got Nothin' Left!
objectivesText: Travel to Kalimdor, to the coastal city of Theramore. From there you must search for an island, south of the main town. Nat Pagle awaits your arrival!

6610.name: Clamlette Surprise
objectivesText: Dirge Quikcleave wants you to get the following items:
12 Giant Eggs. You will find those on the Rocs wandering Tanaris or any other species of large bird.
10 pieces of Zesty Clam Meat. You can find those in clams, naturally!
20 pieces of Alterac Swiss. Get thee to a cheesery!
Gather all of the items and return to Dirge.

6611.name: To Gadgetzan You Go!
objectivesText: Travel to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak with Dirge Quikcleave about advancing your cooking career.

6612.name: I Know A Guy...
objectivesText: Travel to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak with Dirge Quikcleave about advancing your cooking career.

6621.name: King of the Foulweald
objectivesText: Place Karang's Banner on the Foulweald Totem Mound. Do not let the furbolgs destroy the banner. Defeat Chief Murgut and bring Murgut's Totem to Karang Amakkar at Zoram'gar.

6622.name: Triage
objectivesText: Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries.

Remember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldiers. Injured Soldiers take the longest to die and should be saved AFTER your Critically Injured and Badly Injured Soldiers have been triaged.

6623.name: Horde Trauma
objectivesText: Travel to Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands and speak with Doctor Gregory Victor about joining the ranks of Horde Trauma.

6624.name: Triage
objectivesText: Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries.

Remember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldiers. Injured Soldiers take the longest to die and should be saved AFTER your Critically Injured and Badly Injured Soldiers have been triaged.

6625.name: Alliance Trauma
objectivesText: Travel to Theramore in the Dustwallow Marsh and speak with Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen about joining the ranks of Alliance Trauma.

6626.name: A Host of Evil
objectivesText: Kill 8 Razorfen Battleguard, 8 Razorfen Thornweavers, and 8 Death's Head Cultists and return to Myriam Moonsinger near the entrance to Razorfen Downs.

6627.name: Test of Lore
objectivesText: Answer Braug Dimspirit's question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in Stonetalon Mountains when you are ready.

6628.name: Test of Lore
objectivesText: Answer Parqual Fintallas' question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in the Undercity until you are ready.

6629.name: Kill Grundig Darkcloud
objectivesText: Kill Grundig Darkcloud and 6 Grimtotem Brutes, and return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

6641.name: Vorsha the Lasher
objectivesText: Keep Muglash safe as he travels to the brazier. Help him by putting the brazier out, then protect him as you fight against the Naga.
If you are successful, return to the Zoram'gar Outpost and inform the Warsong Runner of the death of Vorsha the Lasher.

6642.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Dark Iron Ore

6643.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Fiery Core

6644.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Lava Core

6645.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Core Leather

6646.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Blood of the Mountain

6661.name: Deeprun Rat Roundup
objectivesText: Capture 5 Deeprun Rats by using the Rat Catcher's Flute. Lead the rats back to Monty. Don't forget to turn in the flute when you're finished.

6662.name: Me Brother, Nipsy
objectivesText: Take the Carton of Mystery Meat to Nipsy at the Stormwind Deeprun Tram Depot.

6681.name: The Manor, Ravenholdt
objectivesText: Take the Seal of Ravenholdt to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor, hidden away in the hills of Hillsbrad.
Your cunning will be tested along the way. Be prepared.

6721.name: The Hunter's Path
objectivesText: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.

6722.name: The Hunter's Path
objectivesText: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.

6761.name: The New Frontier
objectivesText: Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker at the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus.

6762.name: Rabine Saturna
objectivesText: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade. Moonglade lies between Felwood and Winterspring, accessible through a path out of Timbermaw Hold.

6804.name: Poisoned Water
objectivesText: Use the Aspect of Neptulon on poisoned elementals of Eastern Plaguelands. Bring 12 Discordant Bracers and the Aspect of Neptulon to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6805.name: Stormers and Rumblers
objectivesText: Kill 15 Dust Stormers and 15 Desert Rumblers and then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6821.name: Eye of the Emberseer
objectivesText: Bring the Eye of the Emberseer to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6822.name: The Molten Core
objectivesText: Kill 1 Fire Lord, 1 Molten Giant, 1 Ancient Core Hound and 1 Lava Surger, then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6823.name: Agent of Hydraxis
objectivesText: Earn an Honored faction with the Hydraxian Waterlords, then talk to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6824.name: Hands of the Enemy
objectivesText: Bring the Hands of Lucifron, Sulfuron, Gehennas and Shazzrah to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

9665.name: Bolstering Our Defenses
objectivesText: Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands, then return to Emmisary Gormok at Light's Hope Chapel.

9664.name: Establishing New Outposts
objectivesText: Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands, then return to Emmisary Whitebeard at Light's Hope Chapel.

9389.name: Flickering Flames in the Eastern Kingdoms
objectivesText: Visit the bonfires within Hillsbrad Foothills, Silverpine Forest, Westfall, and the Wetlands, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.

9388.name: Flickering Flames in Kalimdor
objectivesText: Visit the bonfires within Ashenvale, the Barrens, Darkshore, and Stonetalon Mountains, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.

9386.name: A Light in Dark Places
objectivesText: Find and touch the bonfires located within Blackrock Spire, Dire Maul, Scholomance, and Stratholme, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.

9378.name: DND FLAG The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas
objectivesText: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will grant you Arcane Cloaking at no cost. You must be Exalted with the Argent Dawn.

9368.name: The Festival of Fire
objectivesText: Touch the bonfires within Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, and the Undercity, then speak to a Festival Talespinner within the capital cities.

9367.name: The Festival of Fire
objectivesText: Touch the bonfires within Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus, then speak to a Festival Loremaster within the capital cities.

9364.name: Fragmented Magic
objectivesText: Polymorph the Spitelash of Azshara and kill the clones that appear several seconds later. When you have slain 50 Polymorph Clones, return to Archmage Xylem in Azshara.

6844.name: Umber, Archivist
objectivesText: Take the Encrusted Silithid Object to Umber - the Cenarion Circle's archivist - in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

6845.name: Uncovering Past Secrets
objectivesText: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

6847.name: Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye
objectivesText: Recover Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye from the Winterax caves and return it to Master Ryson.
Be warned, it is said that Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye carries with it a terrible curse!

6848.name: Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye
objectivesText: Recover Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye from the Winterax caves and return it to Master Ryson.
Be warned, it is said that Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye carries with it a terrible curse!

9362.name: Warlord Krellian
objectivesText: Retrieve the Prismatic Shell for Archmage Xylem. The Archmage resides in a tower atop the cliffs of Azshara.

9332.name: Stealing Darnassus's Flame
objectivesText: Return the Flame of Darnassus to the Festival Talespinner.

9331.name: Stealing Ironforge's Flame
objectivesText: Return the Flame of Ironforge to the Festival Talespinner.

9330.name: Stealing Stormwind's Flame
objectivesText: Return the Flame of Stormwind to the Festival Talespinner.

9326.name: Stealing the Undercity's Flame
objectivesText: Return the Flame of the Undercity to the Festival Loremaster.

9325.name: Stealing Thunder Bluff's Flame
objectivesText: Return the Flame of Thunder Bluff to the Festival Loremaster.

9324.name: Stealing Orgrimmar's Flame
objectivesText: Return the Flame of Orgrimmar to the Festival Loremaster.

9323.name: Wild Fires in the Eastern Kingdoms
objectivesText: Visit the Fire Festival camps located in Blasted Lands, Eastern Plaguelands, the Hinterlands and Searing Gorge, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.

9322.name: Wild Fires in Kalimdor
objectivesText: Visit the Midsummer camps located in Azshara, Silithus, Un'Goro Crater, and Winterspring, then return to the Festival Flamekeeper.

9310.name: Faint Necrotic Crystal
objectivesText: Bring the Faint Necrotic Crystal to Lieutenant Rukag in the courtyard of the Undercity.

9304.name: Document from the Front
objectivesText: Take the Smudged Document to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

9302.name: Missive from the Front
objectivesText: Take the Crumpled Missive to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

9301.name: Envelope from the Front
objectivesText: Take the Bloodstained Envelope to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

9300.name: Page from the Front
objectivesText: Take the Ragged Page to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

9299.name: Note from the Front
objectivesText: Take the Careworn Note to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

9295.name: Letter from the Front
objectivesText: Take the Torn Letter to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

9292.name: Cracked Necrotic Crystal
objectivesText: Bring the Cracked Necrotic Crystal to Lieutenant Orrin outside the gates of Stormwind.

9271.name: Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian
objectivesText: Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants you to take Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian to Stratholme and use it on Consecrated Earth. Defeat the entity that is exorcised from the staff and return to him.

9270.name: Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian
objectivesText: Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants you to take Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian to Stratholme and use it on Consecrated Earth. Defeat the entity that is exorcised from the staff and return to him.

9269.name: Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian
objectivesText: Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants you to take Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian to Stratholme and use it on Consecrated Earth. Defeat the entity that is exorcised from the staff and return to him.

9265.name: Investigate the Scourge of the Undercity
objectivesText: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside the Undercity and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.

9264.name: Investigate the Scourge of Thunder Bluff
objectivesText: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Thunder Bluff and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.

9263.name: Investigate the Scourge of Orgrimmar
objectivesText: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Orgrimmar and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.

9262.name: Investigate the Scourge of Darnassus
objectivesText: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Darnassus and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.

9261.name: Investigate the Scourge of Ironforge
objectivesText: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Ironforge and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.

9260.name: Investigate the Scourge of Stormwind
objectivesText: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Stormwind and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.

9257.name: Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian
objectivesText: Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants you to take Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian to Stratholme and use it on Consecrated Earth. Defeat the entity that is exorcised from the staff and return to him.

9251.name: Atiesh, the Befouled Greatstaff
objectivesText: Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants the Staff Head of Atiesh and the Base of Atiesh.

8762.name: Metzen the Reindeer
objectivesText: Find Metzen the Reindeer. Use the notes provided to you for clues as to where he is being held.
When you find Metzen, have the Pouch of Reindeer Dust in your possession so you can sprinkle some of the dust on him; this should free Metzen from his bonds of captivity.
Return the Pouch of Reindeer Dust to Wulmort Jinglepocket in Ironforge once Metzen is freed.

7361.name: Favor Amongst the Darkspear

Kill a gnome and return to Ravak Grimtotem at Frostwolf Keep with a Tuft of Gnome Hair.

7363.name: The Human Condition

Kill a human and return to Commander Louis Philips (who wanders between the front lines and Frostwolf keep) with a Human Bone Chip.
A cure for the human condition is close at hand!
