objectivesText: Purchase Xorothian Stardust from Ur'dan. Bring it to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

7626.name: Bell of Dethmoora
objectivesText: Bring 10 Elixirs of Shadow Power to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

7627.name: Wheel of the Black March
objectivesText: Bring 6 Large Brilliant Shards and 25 Dark Iron Ore to Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.

7628.name: Doomsday Candle
objectivesText: Bring 35 Black Dragonscales to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

7629.name: Imp Delivery
objectivesText: Bring the Imp in a Jar to the alchemy lab in the Scholomance. After the parchment is created, return the jar to Gorzeeki Wildeyes.

7630.name: Arcanite
objectivesText: Bring 3 Arcanite Bar to Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.

7631.name: Dreadsteed of Xoroth
objectivesText: Read Mor'zul's Instructions. Summon a Xorothian Dreadsteed, defeat it, then bind its spirit to you.

7632.name: The Ancient Leaf
objectivesText: Find the owner of the Ancient Petrified Leaf. Good luck, <Name>; It's a big world.

7634.name: Ancient Sinew Wrapped Lamina
objectivesText: Hastat the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Blue Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Hastat in Felwood.

7635.name: A Proper String
objectivesText: Stoma the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Black Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Stoma in Felwood.

7636.name: Stave of the Ancients
objectivesText: You must find and destroy these four demonic corrupters:
Simone the Seductress.
Klinfran the Crazed.
Solenor the Slayer.
Artorius the Doombringer.
Destroy these creatures and return to Vartrus the Ancient in Felwood with their heads.
Refer to the Petrified Bark in your inventory for clues as to their whereabouts.
You MUST complete this task by yourself.

7637.name: Emphasis on Sacrifice
objectivesText: Travel to Ironforge and get High Priest Rohan's Exorcism Censer. You will need to make a donation of 150 gold in order to secure it.

7638.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
objectivesText: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District.

7639.name: To Show Due Judgment
objectivesText: Return the Exorcism Censer to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

7640.name: Exorcising Terrordale
objectivesText: Use the Exorcism Censer to drive out the spirits that torment Terrordale. When you have slain 25 Terrordale Spirits, return to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

7641.name: The Work of Grimand Elmore
objectivesText: Speak with Grimand Elmore in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

7642.name: Collection of Goods
objectivesText: Bring 40 Runecloth, 6 Arcanite Bars, 10 Arthas' Tears, 5 Stratholme Holy Water vials, and 150 gold to Grimand Elmore in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.

7643.name: Ancient Equine Spirit
objectivesText: Acquire special horse feed used for feeding a spirit horse. Merideth Carlson in Southshore apparently is the source for such food.

Travel to the Dire Maul dungeon in Feralas and slay Tendris Warpwood. Doing so will free the Ancient Equine Spirit. Feed it the special horse feed, thereby soothing the spirit. Finally, give it the Arcanite Barding so it may bless it.

7644.name: Blessed Arcanite Barding
objectivesText: Return with the Blessed Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

7645.name: Manna-Enriched Horse Feed
objectivesText: Retrieve 20 Enriched Manna Biscuits - the key ingredient in making Manna-Enriched Horse Feed - for Merideth Carlson at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. The Argent Dawn is known as the sole purveyor of the biscuits.
You also need to give her 50 gold to soothe her ruffled sensibilities.

7646.name: The Divination Scryer
objectivesText: Bring an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

7647.name: Judgment and Redemption
objectivesText: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance. Doing so will bring forth the spirits you must judge. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver. Defeat him and reclaim the lost soul of the fallen charger.
Give the Charger's Redeemed Soul and the Blessed Enchanted Barding to Darkreaver's Fallen Charger.

7648.name: Grimand's Finest Work
objectivesText: Take the Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District for his inspection.

7649.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume I
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7650.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume II
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7651.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume III
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7667.name: Material Assistance
objectivesText: If you are interested in helping Sagorne Crestrider in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom, bring him an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond.

8548.name: Volunteer's Battlegear
objectivesText: Bring 5 Cenarion Combat Badges, 3 Cenarion Logistics Badges and 7 Cenarion Tactical Badges to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also attain Friendly reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.

8546.name: The Horde Needs More Mithril Bars!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Mithril Bars to Senior Sergeant T'kelah at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.

8545.name: The Horde Needs Mithril Bars!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Mithril Bars to Senior Sergeant T'kelah at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.

7677.name: White Stallion Exchange
objectivesText: If you bring me your white stallion, I'll trade you for one from the new herd. The new horse will be just as fast as your old one, but have a different look to it. You can look at the swift steeds here to see what it will look like.
MUST PAY 500 Gold too....

8544.name: Conqueror's Spaulders
objectivesText: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Command, 2 Idols of Night, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Neutral reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

8542.name: The Horde Needs Tin Bars!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Tin Bars to Grunt Maug at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.

8541.name: Grinding Stones for the Guard
objectivesText: Bring 10 Dense Grinding Stones, 10 Solid Grinding Stones and 10 Heavy Grinding Stones to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing III in order to complete this quest.

8540.name: Boots for the Guard
objectivesText: Bring 3 Ornate Mithril Boots to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing II in order to complete this quest.

8539.name: Target: Hive'Zora Hive Sisters
objectivesText: Slay 30 Hive'Zora Hive Sisters and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing V in order to complete this quest.

8538.name: The Four Dukes
objectivesText: Find a way to summon and slay the Duke of Cynders, the Duke of Fathoms, the Duke of Zephyrs and the Duke of Shards and report back to Commander Mar'alith in Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing V in order to complete this quest.

8537.name: Crimson Templar
objectivesText: Summon and slay a Crimson Templar and report back to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing II in order to complete this quest.

8536.name: Earthen Templar
objectivesText: Summon and slay an Earthen Templar and report back to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing III in order to complete this quest.

8535.name: Hoary Templar
objectivesText: Summon and slay a Hoary Templar and report back to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing IV in order to complete this quest.

8534.name: Hive'Zora Scout Report
objectivesText: Contact Cenarion Scout Azenel inside Hive'Zora and return the Hive'Zora Scout Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing VI in order to complete this quest.

8533.name: The Horde Needs More Copper Bars!
objectivesText: Bring 20 copper bars to Miner Cromwell in Durotar.

8532.name: The Horde Needs Copper Bars!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Copper Bars to Miner Cromwell at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.

8529.name: The Alliance Needs More Spotted Yellowtail!
objectivesText: Bring 20 spotted yellowtail to Huntress Swiftriver at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8528.name: The Alliance Needs Spotted Yellowtail!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Spotted Yellowtail to Huntress Swiftriver at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8527.name: The Alliance Needs More Roast Raptor!
objectivesText: Bring 20 roast raptor to Sarah Sadwhistle at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8526.name: The Alliance Needs Roast Raptor!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Roast Raptor to Sarah Sadwhistle at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8525.name: The Alliance Needs More Rainbow Fin Albacore!
objectivesText: Bring 20 rainbow fin albacore to Slicky Gastronome at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8524.name: The Alliance Needs Rainbow Fin Albacore!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Rainbow Fin Albacore to Slicky Gastronome at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8523.name: The Alliance Needs More Runecloth Bandages!
objectivesText: Bring 20 runecloth bandages to Keeper Moonshade at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8522.name: The Alliance Needs Runecloth Bandages!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Runecloth Bandages to Keeper Moonshade at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8521.name: The Alliance Needs More Silk Bandages!
objectivesText: Bring 20 silk bandages to Nurse Stonefield at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8520.name: The Alliance Needs Silk Bandages!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Silk Bandages to Nurse Stonefield at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

7701.name: WANTED: Overseer Maltorius
objectivesText: Deep within the Slag Pit of the Cauldron, in the Searing Gorge, you will find the traitorous Dark Iron dwarf named Overseer Maltorius.
Slay Overseer Maltorius and take his head. Return the head to Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker in the Searing Gorge for your reward.

8519.name: A Pawn on the Eternal Board
objectivesText: Learn all that you can of the past, then speak with Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

7703.name: Unfinished Gordok Business
objectivesText: Find the Gauntlet of Gordok Might and return it to Captain Kromcrush in Dire Maul.
According to Kromcrush, the "old timey story" says that Tortheldrin - a "creepy" elf who called himself a prince - stole it from one of the Gordok kings.

7704.name: Look at the Size of It!
objectivesText: Take Chambermaid Pillaclencher's Pillow to Evonice Sootsmoker in the Searing Gorge.

8516.name: The Alliance Needs More Thick Leather!
objectivesText: Bring 10 thick leather to Marta Finespindle at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8515.name: The Alliance Needs Thick Leather!
objectivesText: Bring 10 Thick Leather to Marta Finespindle at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8514.name: The Alliance Needs More Medium Leather!
objectivesText: Bring 10 medium leather to Private Porter at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8513.name: The Alliance Needs Medium Leather!
objectivesText: Bring 10 Medium Leather to Private Porter at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8512.name: The Alliance Needs Light Leather!
objectivesText: Bring 10 light leather to Bonnie Stoneflayer at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8511.name: The Alliance Needs Light Leather!
objectivesText: Bring 10 Light Leather to Bonnie Stoneflayer at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8510.name: The Alliance Needs More Arthas' Tears!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Arthas' Tears to Sergeant Major Germaine at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8509.name: The Alliance Needs Arthas' Tears!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Arthas' Tears to Sergeant Major Germaine at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8506.name: The Alliance Needs More Purple Lotus!
objectivesText: Bring 20 purple lotus to Master Nightsong at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8505.name: The Alliance Needs Purple Lotus!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Purple Lotus to Master Nightsong at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8504.name: The Alliance Needs More Stranglekelp!
objectivesText: Bring 20 stranglekelp to Private Draxlegauge at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8503.name: The Alliance Needs Stranglekelp!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Stranglekelp to Private Draxlegauge at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8502.name: Target: Hive'Ashi Workers
objectivesText: Slay 30 Hive'Ashi Workers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing III in order to complete this quest.

8501.name: Target: Hive'Ashi Stingers
objectivesText: Kill 30 Hive'Ashi Stingers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing XII in order to complete this quest.

8500.name: The Alliance Needs More Thorium Bars!
objectivesText: Bring 20 thorium bars to Dame Twinbraid at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

7721.name: Fuel for the Zapping
objectivesText: Collect 10 Water Elemental Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of Feralas, and bring them back to Zorbin Fandazzle who is near the dock there.

7722.name: What the Flux?
objectivesText: Somewhere in the Slag Pit of the Cauldron you will find the Secret Plans: Fiery Flux that Overseer Maltorius stole. Find those plans and return them to Master Smith Burninate in the Searing Gorge.

7723.name: Curse These Fat Fingers
objectivesText: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Heavy War Golems.
The Heavy War Golems wander the areas surrounding the Cauldron in the Searing Gorge. When you've killed enough, return to Hansel in Searing Gorge.

7724.name: Fiery Menace!
objectivesText: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Greater Lava Spiders in the Searing Gorge. You can find Greater Lava Spiders in the plateaus and lava pools of the Searing Gorge.
Return to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge when you have killed enough Greater Lava Spiders.

7725.name: Again With the Zapped Giants
objectivesText: Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker to zap any kind of giant found in Feralas into a more manageable form. Bring 10 Miniaturization Residues found on the zapped versions of these giants to Zorbin Fandazzle at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, Feralas.

7726.name: Refuel for the Zapping
objectivesText: Collect 6 Water Elemental Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of Feralas, and bring them back to Zorbin Fandazzle who is near the dock there.

7727.name: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It
objectivesText: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Incendosaurs.
You will find Incendosaurs occupying the lava pools inside the Slag Pit. The Slag Pit can be found in the Cauldron of the Searing Gorge.
Return to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge when you have killed enough Incendosaurs.

7728.name: STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass
objectivesText: Find and return the Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge.

The only information you have about these items is the following: They were definitely stolen by Dark Iron dwarves. The Smithing Tuyere is a blacksmithing tool used by blacksmiths and the Lookout's Spyglass is an invaluable monitoring tool to lookouts.

7729.name: JOB OPPORTUNITY: Culling the Competition
objectivesText: Slay 15 Dark Iron Taskmasters and 15 Dark Iron Slavers. Return to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge once you have accomplished this task.

7730.name: Zukk'ash Infestation
objectivesText: Bring 20 Zukk'ash Carapaces to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

7731.name: Stinglasher
objectivesText: Defeat Stinglasher in the Writhing Deep, bringing its glands back to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

7732.name: Zukk'ash Report
objectivesText: Deliver the Camp Mojache Zukk'ash Report to Zilzibin Drumlore. He resides in the Drag of Orgrimmar.

7733.name: Improved Quality
objectivesText: Bring 10 Rage Scar Yeti Hides to Pratt McGrubben at Feathermoon Stronghold, Feralas.

7734.name: Improved Quality
objectivesText: Bring 10 Rage Scar Yeti Hides to Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

7735.name: Pristine Yeti Hide
objectivesText: Bring the Pristine Yeti Hide to Pratt McGrubben at the Feathermoon Stronghold, Feralas.

7736.name: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Kingsblood

7738.name: Perfect Yeti Hide
objectivesText: Bring the Perfect Yeti Hide to Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

8499.name: The Alliance Needs Thorium Bars!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Thorium Bars to Dame Twinbraid at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8498.name: Twilight Battle Orders
objectivesText: Obtain the Twilight Battle Orders and bring them Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing X in order to complete this quest.

8497.name: Desert Survival Kits
objectivesText: Bring 4 Globes of Water, 4 Powerful Anti-Venom and 4 Smoked Desert Dumplings to Calandrath at the inn in Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing I in order to complete this quest.

8496.name: Bandages for the Field
objectivesText: Bring 30 Heavy Runecloth Bandages, 30 Heavy Silk Bandages and 30 Heavy Mageweave Bandages to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing X in order to complete this quest.

8495.name: The Alliance Needs More Iron Bars!
objectivesText: Bring 20 iron bars to Corporal Carnes at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8494.name: The Alliance Needs Iron Bars!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Iron Bars to Corporal Carnes at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8493.name: The Alliance Needs More Copper Bars!
objectivesText: Bring 20 copper bars to Sergeant Stonebrow at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8492.name: The Alliance Needs Copper Bars!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Copper Bars to Sergeant Stonebrow at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8485.name: The Brokering of Peace
objectivesText: Bring the Timbermaw Offering of Peace to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

8484.name: The Brokering of Peace
objectivesText: Bring the Timbermaw Offering of Peace to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.

8481.name: The Root of All Evil
objectivesText: Plant the Demon Summoning Torch in the mouth of High Chief Winterfall's cave in the Winterfall furbolg village. Defeat the demon and retrieve the Essence of Xandivious for Gorn One Eye in Timbermaw Hold.

8471.name: Winterfall Ritual Totem
objectivesText: Take the Winterfall Ritual Totem inside Timbermaw Hold and see if one of the furbolgs there will find a use for the item. The Timbermaw will not speak with you unless you are of Neutral reputation or greater with them.

8470.name: Deadwood Ritual Totem
objectivesText: Take the Deadwood Ritual Totem inside Timbermaw Hold and see if one of the furbolgs there will find a use for the item. The Timbermaw will not speak with you unless you are of Neutral reputation or greater with them.

8465.name: Speak to Salfa
objectivesText: Travel through Timbermaw Hold and exit into Winterspring. Speak with Salfa, who stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.

8464.name: Winterfall Activity
objectivesText: Salfa wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Shaman, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Ursa. Salfa is located just outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold in Winterspring.

8462.name: Speak to Nafien
objectivesText: Travel north along the main road in Felwood and speak with the furbolg named Nafien. He stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.

8461.name: Deadwood of the North
objectivesText: Nafien would like you to kill 6 Deadwood Den Watchers, 6 Deadwood Avengers, and 6 Deadwood Shamans. Return to him in northern Felwood near the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.

8460.name: Timbermaw Ally
objectivesText: Grazle wants you to prove yourself by killing 6 Deadwood Warriors, 6 Deadwood Pathfinders, and 6 Deadwood Gardeners. Return to him in southern Felwood near the Emerald Sanctuary when you are done.

8447.name: Waking Legends
objectivesText: Wait for Keeper Remulos at the Moonglade to cleanse the Nightmare Engulfed Object.

7761.name: Blackhand's Command
objectivesText: That is one stupid orc. It would appear as if you need to find this brand and gain the Mark of Drakkisath in order to access the Orb of Command.
The letter indicates that General Drakkisath guards the brand. Perhaps you should investigate.

8446.name: Shrouded in Nightmare
objectivesText: Find someone capable of deciphering the meaning behind the Nightmare Engulfed Object.
Perhaps a druid of great power could assist you.

8439.name: Conquering Arathi Basin
objectivesText: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

8438.name: Conquering Arathi Basin
objectivesText: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

8437.name: Conquering Arathi Basin
objectivesText: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

8436.name: Conquering Arathi Basin
objectivesText: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

8430.name: Battle of Warsong Gulch
objectivesText: Bring 3 Warsong Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

8429.name: Battle of Warsong Gulch
objectivesText: Bring 3 Warsong Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

8428.name: Battle of Warsong Gulch
objectivesText: Bring 3 Warsong Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

8426.name: Battle of Warsong Gulch
objectivesText: Bring 3 Warsong Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

8425.name: Voodoo Feathers
objectivesText: Bring the Voodoo Feathers from the trolls in the Sunken Temple to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

8424.name: War on the Shadowsworn
objectivesText: Slaughter the Shadowsworn in the Blasted Lands and return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

8423.name: Warrior Kinship
objectivesText: Kill 7 Helboar in the Blasted Lands and return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

7781.name: The Lord of Blackrock
objectivesText: Return the Head of Nefarian to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind.

7782.name: The Lord of Blackrock
objectivesText: Venture to the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City and speak with Field Marshal Afrasiabi.

7783.name: The Lord of Blackrock
objectivesText: Return the Head of Nefarian to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

7784.name: The Lord of Blackrock
objectivesText: Speak with High Overlord Saurfang in Orgrimmar. He stands waiting for you in the Valley of Strength.

7785.name: Examine the Vessel
objectivesText: Examine the Vessel of Rebirth and return it to Highlord Demitrian.

7786.name: Thunderaan the Windseeker
objectivesText: To free Thunderaan the Windseeker from his prison, you must present the right and left halves of the Bindings of the Windseeker, 10 bars of Elementium, and the Essence of the Firelord to Highlord Demitrian in Silithus.

7787.name: Rise, Thunderfury!
objectivesText: Present the Dormant Wind Kissed Blade to Highlord Demitrian.

7788.name: Vanquish the Invaders!
objectivesText: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.

7789.name: Quell the Silverwing Usurpers
objectivesText: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Alliance, gain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and bring it to Captain Shatterskull at the Mor'shan Base Camp.

8422.name: Trolls of a Feather
objectivesText: Bring a total of 6 Voodoo Feathers from the trolls in sunken temple.

8421.name: The Wrong Stuff
objectivesText: Bring 10 Rotting Wood and 4 Bloodvenom Essence to Impsy in Felwood.

7810.name: Arena Master
objectivesText: Speak with Short John Mithril in the Stranglethorn Arena.

7815.name: Snapjaws, Mon!
objectivesText: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 15 Saltwater Snapjaw turtles. Return to him when you have completed this task.

7816.name: Gammerita, Mon!
objectivesText: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill Gammerita and retrieve Katoom's Best Lure from her corpse.
Katoom mentioned that Gammerita hangs out on the coast with the other turtles.

7828.name: Stalking the Stalkers
objectivesText: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 10 Silvermane Stalkers and 10 Silvermane Howlers. Return to him once the task is complete.
Markhor mentioned that the wolves hide in the wilds of the Hinterlands.

7829.name: Hunt the Savages
objectivesText: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 20 Savage Owlbeasts. Return to him once the task is complete.
Markhor mentioned that the Savage Owlbeasts occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.

7830.name: Avenging the Fallen
objectivesText: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill a Razorbeak Skylord and retrieve its Skylord Plume. Return to him once the task is complete.
Markhor mentioned that the Razorbeak Skylord are a rare breed that tend to occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.

7839.name: Vilebranch Hooligans
objectivesText: Smith Slagtree at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Slagtree's Lost Tools. Return to him once this task is complete.
You recall Smith Slagtree mentioning that the tools might be at one of the Vilebranch temples in the northeastern region of the Hinterlands. You should also check Skulk Rock.

7840.name: Lard Lost His Lunch
objectivesText: Lard at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Lard's Lunch. Return to him when this task is complete.
Lard mentioned that he left it on the island to the north. Watch out for Vilebranch trolls.

7841.name: Message to the Wildhammer
objectivesText: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to slaughter 15 Highvale Outrunners, 15 Highvale Scouts, 15 Highvale Marksman and 15 Highvale Rangers. Return to him when this task is complete.
You can find the Highvale high elves at the Quel'Danil Lodge in the northwestern region of the Hinterlands.

7842.name: Another Message to the Wildhammer
objectivesText: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to bring him 10 Long Elegant Feathers from the gryphons that inhabit the Hinterlands. Return to him once this task is complete.
Gryphons are known to inhabit every region of the Hinterlands.

7843.name: The Final Message to the Wildhammer
objectivesText: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to travel to Aerie Peak in the western region of the Hinterlands and place the Final Message to the Wildhammer by the well in the center of town. Return to him once this task is complete.
Beware of angry Wildhammer dwarves and unruly members of the Alliance.

7844.name: Cannibalistic Cousins
objectivesText: Mystic Yayo'jin at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 30 Vilebranch Scalpers and 15 Vilebranch Soothsayers. Return to her when this task is complete.
Yayo'jin indicated that these trolls could be found near the Shaol'watha and Agol'watha temples in the north by northeastern region of the Hinterlands.

7845.name: Kidnapped Elder Torntusk!
objectivesText: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to rescue her mate, Elder Torntusk, from Jintha'alor.
You have been told that he is being held prisoner atop Jintha'alor, the Vilebranch capital city located in the southern region of the Hinterlands.

7846.name: Recover the Key!
